# commieD-Idea

01main requisites
- Multiplayer maze shooter (browser-based)
- Large scale: 1000s of concurrent players across 200 cities globally
- Goal: be the last team standing
- the entire game is minimal in design and assets with the theme of communism(cause commieD=comm(unist)i(com)eD(y))
- Teams are divided uniformly.
- Teams share everything(from ammo, dashes, and even HP)
- If the team HP goes to 0, the entire team dies.
- A team is revived with only n/2 of the number of players who were alive in the previous run.
- the players who get to live is decided by a random player in the team.
- dead players(the n/2 not selected to play), act as ghosts, who search and collect resources for the team.
- on the number of players in team reaching one, the team dies. and is eliminated.
02actual gameplay
- the entire game happens in a limited procedurally generated maze.
- each team begins in a large empty space surrounded by the maze. which is its spawn point. enemies cannot enter here. and spawn vulnerability is also here. 
- the whole game is top down 2d.
- the screen will consist of the following:
.top left=minimap which will either show the nearby area, minimap of the whole maze or a list of your teammates which you can quickly select from by using arrow keys to get the route to them.(these different modes can be switched by using x key)
.top center=performance and connection stats. strip format. with colour change for good, acceptable and bad stat values.
.bottom left=team reserves(ammo, dash, current powerup)
.bottom center=team health
.top right=comrats(stats of your comrades)
- you move around with wasd and arrowkeys, shift to dash. mouse to aim and click to shoot. hold click to for continuous fire. space for using special item
- special items are found around the world as collectibles strewn around in mazes
- the maze itself is a tiled system containing the following types of tiles: wall, free space,. this is saved and used by program with the help of a 1d array whose scale is fixed at a square for now.
- for ghosts, they can immediately switch between different tasks by using 1,2,3(clicker,ammo,dash)
- special items that can be triggered with space are 1 time and everyone gets the special item. in case more are collected, they become the current special item and the item before it is saved and becomes current item again when special items is empty. anybody can use this item and exhaust it for the entire team.(communism at peak).
- special items cannot be stacked. one can only be triggered when there are no current effects. effects are applied teamwide when triggered.
-special items can randomly spawn on any free 
03maze design:
- the maze is a structure with large spaces for the team spawn points.
- it will be a 3 pass system. first randomly set the spawn areas fo the different teams, then generate the maze then at last generate the special items.
- each tile is the same size as the player. the player is a circle with 1 pointed end. acting as gunpoint.
- the spawnpoint area is calculated as the sum of all the tiles per player(2 tiles per player). converted into a rectangle where the length and breadth have least difference.=====SPECIAL=====
gun=generic. -1hp ber bullet. 10 bullets per second.(default weapon)(not actually special)
bomb= -100hp on contact. radius of impact=2 tiles.
+hp=+300Hp immediately when collected. consumed immediately.
+speed=+40sec immediately when collected. consumed immediately.
gun+=better gun with -2hp per bullet for 2mins. triggered by using space
fwaless=can phase through walls for 20 seconds. when triggered
+coat=immunity from damage for 20seconds. 0.4x speed

271:         if (event.duplicate) {
272:           toast(`${meta.name} — ALREADY HELD`);
273:         } else if (event.immediate) {
274:           toast(`${meta.name} ADDED TO TEAM RESERVES`, 'good');
275:         } else {
276:           toast(`${meta.name} — PRESS SPACE TO SHARE`, 'good');
277:         }
278:         break;
279:       }
280:       case 'special-used': {
281:         const meta = ITEM_META[event.type];
282:         toast(`${meta.name} TRIGGERED FOR THE TEAM`, 'good');
283:         break;
284:       }
285:       case 'team-downed': {
286:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
287:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
288:           toast('TEAM DOWN — HALF WILL RETURN', 'bad');
289:         } else {
290:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} DOWN`, 'good');
291:         }
292:         break;
293:       }
294:       case 'team-revived': {
295:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
296:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
297:           toast(`REVIVED ${event.living} COMRADES — ${event.hp} HP`, 'good');
298:         } else {
299:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} REVIVED ${event.living}`, 'bad');
300:         }
301:         break;
302:       }
303:       case 'team-eliminated': {
304:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
305:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
306:           showBanner('ELIMINATED', 'Press R for a new match');
307:         } else {
308:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} ELIMINATED`, 'good');
309:         }
310:         break;
311:       }
312:       case 'effect-ended':
313:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
314:           toast(`${EFFECT_NAMES[event.effect] ?? event.effect} EXPIRED`);
315:         }
316:         break;
317:       default:
318:         break;
319:     }
320:   }
321: }
322: 
323: function showBanner(title, text) {
324:   ui.bannerTitle.textContent = title;
325:   ui.bannerText.textContent = text;
326:   ui.banner.hidden = false;
327: }
328: 
329: function toast(message, tone = '') {
330:   const element = document.createElement('div');
331:   element.className = `toast${tone ? ` is-${tone}` : ''}`;
332:   element.textContent = message;
333:   ui.toasts.append(element);
334: 
335:   while (ui.toasts.children.length > 4) {
336:     ui.toasts.firstElementChild.remove();
337:   }
338: 
339:   window.setTimeout(() => element.remove(), 2600);
340: }
341: 
342: /* ---------- Render ---------- */
343: 
344: function render(now) {
345:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
346:   ctx.fillStyle = '#070605';
347:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
348: 
349:   drawTiles();
350:   drawSpawnZones();
351:   drawItems(now);
352:   drawBombs(now);
353:   drawBullets();
354:   drawPlayers(now);
355:   drawEffects();
356:   drawCrosshair();
357: 
358:   if (game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
359:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6, 4, 4, 0.45)';
360:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
361:   }
362: }
363: 
364: function drawTiles() {
365:   const halfWidth = viewWidth / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
366:   const halfHeight = viewHeight / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
367:   const minX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.x - halfWidth));
368:   const maxX = Math.min(game.maze.width - 1, Math.ceil(camera.x + halfWidth));
369:   const minY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.y - halfHeight));
370:   const maxY = Math.min(game.maze.height - 1, Math.ceil(camera.y + halfHeight));
371: 
372:   const wallShades = ['#3b3328', '#352e24', '#41382b'];
373: 
374:   for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y += 1) {
375:     for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += 1) {
376:       const [screenX, screenY] = worldToScreen(x, y);
377:       const wall = game.maze.tiles[y * game.maze.width + x] === TILE.WALL;
378: 
379:       if (wall) {
380:         const shade = wallShades[(x * 31 + y * 17) % wallShades.length];
381:         ctx.fillStyle = shade;
382:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
383:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28)';
384:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 5, TILE_PX + 0.5, 5);
385:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
386:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, 2);
387:       } else {
388:         ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? '#0d0b09' : '#0b0a08';
389:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
390:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018)';
391:         ctx.fillRect(screenX + TILE_PX - 1, screenY, 1, TILE_PX);
392:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 1, TILE_PX, 1);
393:       }
394: 
395:       const owner = spawnTeamAt(game.maze, x, y);
396:       if (owner >= 0 && !wall) {
397:         ctx.fillStyle = withAlpha(game.teams[owner].color, 0.07);
398:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
399:       }
400:     }
401:   }
402: }
403: 
404: function drawSpawnZones() {
405:   for (const spawn of game.maze.spawns) {
406:     const team = game.teams[spawn.teamId];
407:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(spawn.x, spawn.y);
408:     ctx.strokeStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.45);
409:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
410:     ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
411:     ctx.strokeRect(x, y, spawn.width * TILE_PX, spawn.height * TILE_PX);
412:     ctx.setLineDash([]);
413: 
414:     ctx.fillStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.6);
415:     ctx.font = '700 9px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
416:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
417:     ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
418:     ctx.fillText(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} SPAWN`, x + 3, y - 4);
419:   }
420: }
421: 
422: function drawItems(now) {
423:   const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(now / 240) * 0.08;
424: 
425:   for (const item of game.maze.items) {
426:     if (item.taken) {
427:       continue;
428:     }
429: 
430:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(item.x + 0.5, item.y + 0.5);
431:     if (x < -40 || y < -40 || x > viewWidth + 40 || y > viewHeight + 40) {
432:       continue;
433:     }
434: 
435:     const meta = ITEM_META[item.type];
436:     ctx.save();
437:     ctx.translate(x, y);
438:     ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
439:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.85)';
440:     ctx.strokeStyle = meta.color;
441:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
442:     ctx.beginPath();
443:     ctx.roundRect(-9, -9, 18, 18, 3);
444:     ctx.fill();
445:     ctx.stroke();
446:     ctx.fillStyle = meta.color;
447:     ctx.font = '700 10px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
448:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
449:     ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
450:     ctx.fillText(meta.label, 0, 0.5);
451:     ctx.restore();
452:   }
453: }
454: 
455: function drawBombs(now) {
456:   for (const bomb of game.bombs) {
457:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(bomb.x, bomb.y);
458:     const flicker = 0.6 + Math.sin(now / 60) * 0.4;
459:     ctx.beginPath();
460:     ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
461:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2a0f0f';
462:     ctx.fill();
463:     ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 90, 80, ${flicker})`;
464:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
465:     ctx.stroke();
466:     ctx.beginPath();
467:     ctx.arc(x + 4, y - 7, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
468:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c94c';
469:     ctx.fill();
470:   }
471: }
472: 
473: function drawBullets() {
474:   ctx.lineCap = 'round';
475: 
476:   for (const bullet of game.bullets) {
477:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(bullet.x, bullet.y);
478:     const length = Math.hypot(bullet.vx, bullet.vy) || 1;
479:     const trailX = (bullet.vx / length) * 10;
480:     const trailY = (bullet.vy / length) * 10;
481: 
482:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8e7ab';
483:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
484:     ctx.beginPath();
485:     ctx.moveTo(x, y);
486:     ctx.lineTo(x - trailX, y - trailY);
487:     ctx.stroke();
488: 
489:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.25)';
490:     ctx.lineWidth = 5;
491:     ctx.beginPath();
492:     ctx.moveTo(x, y);
493:     ctx.lineTo(x - trailX, y - trailY);
494:     ctx.stroke();
495:   }
496: 
497:   ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
498: }
499: 
500: function drawPlayers(now) {
501:   for (const player of game.players) {
502:     const team = game.teams[player.teamId];
503:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(player.x, player.y);
504:     const radius = PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX;
505:     const isMe = player.id === me.id;
506: 
507:     ctx.save();
508:     ctx.globalAlpha = player.alive ? 1 : 0.4;
509: 
510:     if (!player.alive) {
511:       ctx.strokeStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.8);
512:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
513:       ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
514:       ctx.beginPath();
515:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius + 4 + Math.sin(now / 300 + player.id) * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
516:       ctx.stroke();
517:       ctx.setLineDash([]);
518:     }
519: 
520:     // Gun barrel
521:     const gunLength = radius * 1.7;
522:     const gunX = Math.cos(player.angle);
523:     const gunY = Math.sin(player.angle);
524:     const perpX = -gunY;
525:     const perpY = gunX;
526:     ctx.beginPath();
527:     ctx.moveTo(x + gunX * gunLength, y + gunY * gunLength);
528:     ctx.lineTo(x + perpX * 3, y + perpY * 3);
529:     ctx.lineTo(x - perpX * 3, y - perpY * 3);
530:     ctx.closePath();
531:     ctx.fillStyle = player.alive ? '#e9dfc5' : withAlpha('#e9dfc5', 0.5);
532:     ctx.fill();
533: 
534:     // Body
535:     ctx.beginPath();
536:     ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
537:     ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
538:     ctx.fill();
539:     ctx.lineWidth = isMe ? 2.5 : 1.5;
540:     ctx.strokeStyle = isMe ? '#ffffff' : '#100d09';
541:     ctx.stroke();
542: 
543:     if (isMe) {
544:       ctx.beginPath();
545:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
546:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.7)';
547:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
548:       ctx.setLineDash([2, 4]);
549:       ctx.stroke();
550:       ctx.setLineDash([]);
551:     }
552: 
553:     if (player.teamId === me.teamId) {
554:       ctx.globalAlpha = player.alive ? 0.85 : 0.5;
555:       ctx.fillStyle = '#d7cfb9';
556:       ctx.font = '700 7.5px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
557:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
558:       ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
559:       ctx.fillText(isMe ? 'YOU' : player.name.toUpperCase(), x, y - radius - 5);
560:     }
561: 
562:     ctx.restore();
563:   }
564: }
565: 
566: function drawEffects() {
567:   for (const effect of effects) {
568:     const progress = 1 - effect.life / effect.total;
569: 
570:     if (effect.type === 'blast') {
571:       const [x, y] = worldToScreen(effect.x, effect.y);
572:       const radius = effect.radius * TILE_PX * progress;
573:       ctx.beginPath();
574:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
575:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(242, 120, 60, ${0.28 * (1 - progress)})`;
576:       ctx.fill();
577:       ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 210, 140, ${0.8 * (1 - progress)})`;
578:       ctx.lineWidth = 3;
579:       ctx.stroke();
580:     } else if (effect.type === 'flash') {
581:       const player = game.playersById.get(effect.playerId);
582:       if (!player) {
583:         continue;
584:       }
585:       const [x, y] = worldToScreen(player.x, player.y);
586:       const muzzleX = x + Math.cos(player.angle) * PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX * 1.9;
587:       const muzzleY = y + Math.sin(player.angle) * PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX * 1.9;
588:       ctx.beginPath();
589:       ctx.arc(muzzleX, muzzleY, 5 * (1 - progress) + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
590:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 236, 160, ${1 - progress})`;
591:       ctx.fill();
592:     }
593:   }
594: }
595: 
596: function drawCrosshair() {
597:   ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.55)';
598:   ctx.lineWidth = 1;
599:   ctx.beginPath();
600:   ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
601:   ctx.stroke();
602:   ctx.beginPath();
603:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x - 11, mouse.y);
604:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x - 3, mouse.y);
605:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x + 3, mouse.y);
606:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x + 11, mouse.y);
607:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 11);
608:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 3);
609:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 3);
610:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 11);
611:   ctx.stroke();
612: }
613: 
614: /* ---------- HUD ---------- */
615: 
616: function updateHud(now) {
617:   updateEffects(now);
618: 
619:   if (now >= hudNext) {
620:     hudNext = now + 120;
621:     updateStats();
622:     updateReserves();
623:     updateHealth();
624:     updateMinimap();
625:   }
626: 
627:   if (now >= comratsNext) {
628:     comratsNext = now + 260;
629:     updateComrats();
630:   }
631: }
632: 
633: function updateEffects(now) {
634:   const delta = lastFrame === 0 ? 16 : Math.min(100, now - lastFrame);
635:   effects = effects.filter((effect) => {
636:     effect.life -= delta;
637:     return effect.life > 0;
638:   });
639: }
640: 
641: function updateStats() {
642:   ui.stats.fps.textContent = `FPS ${Math.round(fps)}`;
643:   ui.stats.fps.className = `stat ${fps >= 50 ? '' : fps >= 30 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;
644: 
645:   ui.stats.frame.textContent = `${frameMs.toFixed(1)} ms`;
646:   ui.stats.frame.className = `stat ${frameMs <= 20 ? '' : frameMs <= 33 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;
647: 
648:   ui.stats.conn.textContent = 'LOCAL';
649:   ui.stats.conn.className = 'stat is-dim';
650: 
651:   const aliveA = game.teams[0].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(0);
652:   const aliveB = game.teams[1].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(1);
653:   ui.stats.alive.textContent = `${aliveA} / ${aliveB}`;
654:   ui.stats.alive.className = 'stat is-dim';
655: }
656: 
657: function countAlive(teamId) {
658:   return game.players.filter((player) => player.teamId === teamId && player.alive).length;
659: }
660: 
661: function updateReserves() {
662:   const team = game.teams[me.teamId];
663:   ui.teamName.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
664:   ui.ammo.textContent = String(team.ammo);
665:   ui.dash.textContent = `${Math.floor(team.dashSeconds)}s`;
666:   ui.special.textContent = team.specials.length
667:     ? ITEM_META[team.specials[team.specials.length - 1]].name
668:     : '—';
669: 
670:   const queue = team.specials.map((type, index) => {
671:     const span = document.createElement('span');
672:     const current = index === team.specials.length - 1;
673:     span.textContent = ITEM_META[type].name;
674:     if (current) {
675:       span.className = 'is-current';
676:     }
677:     return span;
678:   });
679:   ui.specialQueue.replaceChildren(...queue);
680: }
681: 
682: function updateHealth() {
683:   const team = game.teams[me.teamId];
684:   const maxHp = Math.max(1, team.maxHp);
685:   const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, team.hp / maxHp));
686: 
687:   ui.healthTeam.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
688:   ui.hpLabel.textContent = `${Math.round(team.hp)} / ${Math.round(team.maxHp)}`;
689:   ui.hpFill.style.width = `${ratio * 100}%`;
690:   ui.hpFill.className = `health__fill${
691:     ratio <= 0.34 ? ' is-low' : ratio <= 0.67 ? ' is-mid' : ''
692:   }`;
693: 
694:   if (team.activeEffect) {
695:     const seconds = Math.max(0, team.activeEffect.msLeft / 1000);
696:     ui.effectLabel.textContent = `${EFFECT_NAMES[team.activeEffect.type] ?? team.activeEffect.type} ${seconds.toFixed(0)}s`;
697:   } else {
698:     ui.effectLabel.textContent = 'NO EFFECT';
699:   }
700: 
701:   if (team.eliminated) {
702:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = 'ELIMINATED';
703:     showBanner('ELIMINATED', 'Press R for a new match');
704:   } else if (!me.alive) {
705:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = `GHOST · ${TASK_NAMES[me.ghostTask] ?? 'CLICKER'}`;
706:     ui.banner.hidden = true;
707:   } else {
708:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = 'LIVE';
709:     ui.banner.hidden = true;
710:   }
711: }
712: 
713: function updateComrats() {
714:   const teamPlayers = game.players
715:     .filter((player) => player.teamId === me.teamId)
716:     .sort((a, b) => Number(b.alive) - Number(a.alive) || a.id - b.id);
717: 
718:   const rows = teamPlayers.map((player) => {
719:     const item = document.createElement('li');
720:     if (player.id === me.id) {
721:       item.className = 'is-me';
722:     } else if (!player.alive) {
723:       item.className = 'is-dead';
724:     }
725: 
726:     const name = document.createElement('span');
727:     name.textContent = player.id === me.id ? 'YOU' : player.name.toUpperCase();
728: 
729:     const state = document.createElement('span');
730:     state.className = `comrat__state ${
731:       !player.alive ? 'is-ghost' : 'is-live'
732:     }`;
733:     state.textContent = player.alive ? 'LIVE' : 'GHOST';
734: 
735:     item.append(name, state);
736:     return item;
737:   });
738: 
739:   if (game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
740:     const item = document.createElement('li');
741:     item.className = 'is-dead';
742:     const name = document.createElement('span');
743:     name.textContent = 'TEAM ELIMINATED';
744:     item.append(name);
745:     rows.unshift(item);
746:   }
747: 
748:   ui.comrats.replaceChildren(...rows);
749:   ui.comratsCount.textContent = `${countAlive(me.teamId)} LIVE`;
750: }
751: 
752: function updateMinimap() {
753:   ui.minimapMode.textContent = MINIMAP_MODES[minimapModeIndex];
754:   const size = MINIMAP_SIZE;
755:   minimapCtx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
756: 
757:   if (!mazeBitmap) {
758:     return;
759:   }
760: 
761:   const mode = MINIMAP_MODES[minimapModeIndex];
762: 
763:   if (mode === 'COMRATS') {
764:     drawTeamMap();
765:     return;
766:   }
767: 
768:   let sourceX = 0;
769:   let sourceY = 0;
770:   let sourceWidth = game.maze.width;
771:   let sourceHeight = game.maze.height;
772: 
773:   if (mode === 'NEARBY') {
774:     const span = 25;
775:     sourceWidth = span;
776:     sourceHeight = span;
777:     sourceX = clamp(me.x - span / 2, 0, game.maze.width - span);
778:     sourceY = clamp(me.y - span / 2, 0, game.maze.height - span);
779:   }
780: 
781:   minimapCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
782:   minimapCtx.drawImage(
783:     mazeBitmap,
784:     sourceX,
785:     sourceY,
786:     sourceWidth,
787:     sourceHeight,
788:     0,
789:     0,
790:     size,
791:     size,
792:   );
793: 
794:   const project = (x, y) => [
795:     ((x - sourceX) / sourceWidth) * size,
796:     ((y - sourceY) / sourceHeight) * size,
797:   ];
798: 
799:   for (const item of game.maze.items) {
800:     if (item.taken) {
801:       continue;
802:     }
803:     const [x, y] = project(item.x + 0.5, item.y + 0.5);
804:     minimapCtx.fillStyle = '#f2c94c';
805:     minimapCtx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 1, 2, 2);
806:   }
807: 
808:   for (const player of game.players) {
809:     const [x, y] = project(player.x, player.y);
810:     const team = game.teams[player.teamId];
811:     minimapCtx.globalAlpha = player.alive ? 1 : 0.45;
812:     minimapCtx.beginPath();
813:     minimapCtx.arc(x, y, player.id === me.id ? 2.6 : 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
814:     minimapCtx.fillStyle = team.color;
815:     minimapCtx.fill();
816:     if (player.id === me.id) {
817:       minimapCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
818:       minimapCtx.lineWidth = 1;
819:       minimapCtx.stroke();
820:     }
821:   }
822:   minimapCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
823: 
824:   if (mode === 'FULL') {
825:     const viewTilesX = viewWidth / TILE_PX;
826:     const viewTilesY = viewHeight / TILE_PX;
827:     const [x, y] = project(camera.x - viewTilesX / 2, camera.y - viewTilesY / 2);
828:     minimapCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35)';
829:     minimapCtx.lineWidth = 1;
830:     minimapCtx.strokeRect(
831:       x,
832:       y,
833:       (viewTilesX / sourceWidth) * size,
834:       (viewTilesY / sourceHeight) * size,
835:     );
836:   }
837: }

839: function drawTeamMap() {

37: /** Small, fast, deterministic 32-bit PRNG. */
38: export function mulberry32(seed) {
39:   let state = seed >>> 0;
40:   return function next() {
41:     state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
42:     let t = state;
43:     t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
44:     t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
45:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
46:   };
47: }

49: export function makeRng(seed) {
50:   const next = mulberry32(seed);
51:   return {
52:     next,
53:     int(max) {
54:       return Math.floor(next() * max);
55:     },
56:     pick(list) {
57:       return list[this.int(list.length)];
58:     },
59:     shuffle(list) {
60:       for (let index = list.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
61:         const swap = this.int(index + 1);
62:         [list[index], list[swap]] = [list[swap], list[index]];
63:       }
64:       return list;
65:     },
66:   };
67: }

176: function placeSpawnZones(rng, width, height, teams, playersPerTeam) {
177:   const area = Math.max(2, playersPerTeam * 2);
178:   const { width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight } = bestRectangle(area);
179:   const zones = [];
180: 
181:   if (roomWidth + 2 >= width || roomHeight + 2 >= height) {
182:     throw new RangeError('map is too small for the spawn room size');
183:   }
184: 
185:   for (let teamId = 0; teamId < teams; teamId += 1) {
186:     let placed = null;

188:     for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 600 && !placed; attempt += 1) {
189:       const x = 1 + rng.int(width - roomWidth - 2);
190:       const y = 1 + rng.int(height - roomHeight - 2);
191: 
192:       if (x + roomWidth > width - 1 || y + roomHeight > height - 1) {
193:         continue;
194:       }
195: 
196:       const candidate = { x, y, width: roomWidth, height: roomHeight };
197: 
198:       if (zones.some((zone) => rectsOverlap(candidate, zone, 3))) {
199:         continue;
200:       }
201: 
202:       placed = candidate;
203:     }
204: 
205:     if (!placed) {
206:       throw new RangeError('map is too small for every spawn room');
207:     }
208: 
209:     zones.push({ teamId, ...placed });

212:   return zones;

215: function rectsOverlap(a, b, padding) {

224: function carveMaze(rng, tiles, width, height) {
225:   const startX = 1;

235:   tiles[startY * width + startX] = TILE.FREE;
236: 
237:   while (stack.length > 0) {
238:     const [x, y] = stack[stack.length - 1];
239:     const options = [];

241:     for (const [dx, dy] of directions) {
242:       const nextX = x + dx;
243:       const nextY = y + dy;
244: 
245:       if (nextX <= 0 || nextY <= 0 || nextX >= width - 1 || nextY >= height - 1) {
246:         continue;
247:       }
248:       if (tiles[nextY * width + nextX] === TILE.WALL) {
249:         options.push([nextX, nextY, dx, dy]);
250:       }
251:     }
252: 
253:     if (options.length === 0) {
254:       stack.pop();
255:       continue;
256:     }
257: 
258:     const [nextX, nextY, dx, dy] = options[rng.int(options.length)];
259:     tiles[(y + dy / 2) * width + (x + dx / 2)] = TILE.FREE;
260:     tiles[nextY * width + nextX] = TILE.FREE;
261:     stack.push([nextX, nextY]);
262:   }
263: }

265: function carveRoom(tiles, width, room) {
266:   for (let y = room.y; y < room.y + room.height; y += 1) {
267:     for (let x = room.x; x < room.x + room.width; x += 1) {
268:       tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
269:     }
270:   }
271: }

273: function connectRooms(tiles, width, from, to) {
274:   const fromX = from.x + Math.floor(from.width / 2);
275:   const fromY = from.y + Math.floor(from.height / 2);
276:   const toX = to.x + Math.floor(to.width / 2);
277:   const toY = to.y + Math.floor(to.height / 2);
278: 
279:   carveHorizontal(tiles, width, fromX, toX, fromY);
280:   carveVertical(tiles, width, fromY, toY, toX);

283: function carveHorizontal(tiles, width, x1, x2, y) {
284:   const start = Math.min(x1, x2);
285:   const end = Math.max(x1, x2);
286: 
287:   for (let x = start; x <= end; x += 1) {
288:     tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
289:   }
290: }
291: 
292: function carveVertical(tiles, width, y1, y2, x) {
293:   const start = Math.min(y1, y2);
294:   const end = Math.max(y1, y2);
295: 
296:   for (let y = start; y <= end; y += 1) {
297:     tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;
298:   }
299: }

301: function rollItemType(rng) {
302:   const total = ITEM_TYPES.reduce((sum, type) => sum + ITEM_WEIGHTS[type], 0);
303:   let roll = rng.next() * total;
304: 
305:   for (const type of ITEM_TYPES) {
306:     roll -= ITEM_WEIGHTS[type];
307:     if (roll < 0) {
308:       return type;
309:     }
310:   }
311: 
312:   return ITEM_TYPES[ITEM_TYPES.length - 1];
313: }

315: function scatterItems(rng, { tiles, spawnZones, width, height, count }) {
316:   const candidates = [];
317: 
318:   for (let y = 1; y < height - 1; y += 1) {
319:     for (let x = 1; x < width - 1; x += 1) {
320:       const index = y * width + x;
321:       if (tiles[index] === TILE.FREE && spawnZones[index] === -1) {
322:         candidates.push({ x, y });
323:       }
324:     }
325:   }
326: 
327:   rng.shuffle(candidates);
328: 
329:   const items = [];
330:   const limit = Math.min(count, candidates.length);
331: 
332:   for (let index = 0; index < limit; index += 1) {
333:     items.push({
334:       id: index + 1,
335:       type: rollItemType(rng),
336:       x: candidates[index].x,
337:       y: candidates[index].y,
338:       taken: false,
339:     });
340:   }
341: 
342:   return items;

1: # commieD — Minigame Agent Notes
2: 
3: ## Scope
4: - This repository is now **only for ghost minigames**. Another developer owns the main game: maze, movement, combat, teams, death/revival, and multiplayer.
5: - Do not build or modify main-game systems here, and do not restore the old client/server/shared implementation.
6: - Minigames:
7:   - Soul Clicker (Soul Contribution / HP clicker)
8:   - Bullet Press
9:   - Stewed Luck (power-up spin)
10:   - Dash Supplement Factory
11: - `minigames.md` holds the working specs, pseudocode notes, and unresolved questions. Read it before implementing.
12: - `idea.md` is the product source of truth. Never edit it.
13: - `checklist.md` is intentionally empty. Add only minigame tasks and tick items only after verification.
14: 
15: ## Current state
16: - The workspace was intentionally cleared and is now minigame-only. There is no root `package.json` or shared tooling; each minigame is self-contained.
17: - Previous main-game code was deleted on purpose. Do not recover it from git history.
18: - The `.py` files and `dash supplement factory` notes are user-written draft pseudocode, not production implementations.
19: - Soul Clicker is implemented in `soul-clicker/` and Bullet Press in `bullet-press/` (vanilla ES modules + `node --test`). Stewed Luck and Dash Supplement Factory are not started.
20: 
21: ## Integration contract
22: - Build each minigame as a self-contained module with a narrow interface: explicit inputs/state in, resources/events out.
23: - Do not own the main game loop, networking, or global game state. The host game will integrate the module.
24: - Keep game logic deterministic and testable; avoid wall-clock time inside rules.
25: - Use placeholder assets until real assets arrive, and keep asset paths centralized.
26: 
27: ## Minigame rules to follow
28: - **Soul Clicker:** at 5 CPS generate +1 HP/s, banked until needed; below 5 CPS lose 0.2 HP/s. No HP cap for teams with ghosts. Normal team regen is disabled while ghosts exist. HP bar is red below `100 × living teammates`, yellow through `+90`, green above. Random shapes spawn every 10–30 s for a small HP bonus.
29: - **Bullet Press:** players follow keyboard sequences to make magazines. Imperfect magazines are rejected and the sequence restarts. Mistakes drop the production multiplier toward 0.5x; a long clean streak raises it slowly to 5x.
30: - **Stewed Luck:** live-player kills earn killmit; spend it to spin the pot for a special power-up.
31: - **Dash Supplement Factory:** follow the pot-preparation order exactly; any mistake destroys the whole batch. 1 pot = 20 seconds of speed, 1 bottle = 1 second.
32: 
33: ## Rules
34: - One small step at a time; do not scaffold the whole system at once.
35: - Commit after each completed step; never include unrelated or user changes.
36: - Test as you go, with only the minimal tooling a minigame needs.
37: - Do not reintroduce ghost shooting.
38: - Update `checklist.md` at the end of each request when work is completed.

+function findRoute(from, to) {
+  if (!from || !to || from.id === to.id) {
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  // Ghosts pass through walls, so a straight line is the honest route.
+  if (from.isGhost) {
+    return [
+      { x: from.x, y: from.y },
+      { x: to.x, y: to.y },
+    ];
+  }
+
+  const { width, height } = game.maze;
+  const startX = clamp(Math.floor(from.x), 0, width - 1);
+  const startY = clamp(Math.floor(from.y), 0, height - 1);
+  let goalX = clamp(Math.floor(to.x), 0, width - 1);
+  let goalY = clamp(Math.floor(to.y), 0, height - 1);
+
+  if (isWall(game.maze, goalX, goalY)) {
+    const near = nearestFreeTile(goalX, goalY, 3);
+    if (!near) {
+      return [];
+    }
+    goalX = near.x;
+    goalY = near.y;
+  }
+
+  const keyOf = (x, y) => y * width + x;
+  const startKey = keyOf(startX, startY);
+  const goalKey = keyOf(goalX, goalY);
+  const cameFrom = new Map([[startKey, null]]);
+  const queue = [[startX, startY]];
+  let head = 0;
+  let found = startKey === goalKey;
+
+  while (head < queue.length && !found) {
+    const [x, y] = queue[head];
+    head += 1;
+
+    for (const [dx, dy] of [
+      [1, 0],
+      [-1, 0],
+      [0, 1],
+      [0, -1],
+    ]) {
+      const nextX = x + dx;
+      const nextY = y + dy;
+      const key = keyOf(nextX, nextY);
+
+      if (nextX < 0 || nextY < 0 || nextX >= width || nextY >= height) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (cameFrom.has(key)) {
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (isWall(game.maze, nextX, nextY)) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const owner = spawnTeamAt(game.maze, nextX, nextY);
+      if (owner !== -1 && owner !== from.teamId) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      cameFrom.set(key, keyOf(x, y));
+
+      if (key === goalKey) {
+        found = true;
+        break;
+      }
+
+      queue.push([nextX, nextY]);
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!found) {
+    return [];
+  }
+
+  const path = [];
+  let cursor = goalKey;
+
+  while (cursor !== null) {
+    const x = cursor % width;
+    const y = Math.floor(cursor / width);
+    path.push({ x: x + 0.5, y: y + 0.5 });
+    cursor = cameFrom.get(cursor);
+  }
+
+  path.reverse();
+  path[0] = { x: from.x, y: from.y };
+  path[path.length - 1] = { x: to.x, y: to.y };
+  return path;
+}
+
+function nearestFreeTile(x, y, radius) {
+  for (let ring = 0; ring <= radius; ring += 1) {
+    for (let dy = -ring; dy <= ring; dy += 1) {
+      for (let dx = -ring; dx <= ring; dx += 1) {
+        if (Math.max(Math.abs(dx), Math.abs(dy)) !== ring) {
+          continue;
+        }
+        const nextX = x + dx;
+        const nextY = y + dy;
+        if (!isWall(game.maze, nextX, nextY)) {
+          return { x: nextX, y: nextY };
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}

No build step or dependencies are required.\n\n## Test\n\n```sh\ncd main-game\nnpm test\n```\n\nThe suite covers the three-pass maze generator, shared team resources, combat,\nspecial items, ghost tasks, revival, elimination, and winner detection.\n\n## Controls\n\n| Input | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| `WASD` / arrows | Move |\n| Mouse | Aim |\n| Click / hold | Shoot |\n| `Shift` | Dash |\n| `Space` | Trigger the team special item |\n| `X` | Cycle minimap: nearby → full maze → comrats |\n| `↑` / `↓` in comrats | Select a teammate and draw a route |\n| `1` / `2` / `3` | Ghost task: clicker / ammo / dash |\n| `R` | New match |\n\n## Structure\n\n- `src/maze.js` — deterministic three-pass maze: spawn rooms, carved maze, items.\n- `src/game.js` — pure rules: shared HP/ammo/dash, movement, combat, specials,\n  ghosts, revival, elimination, winner. It does not read wall-clock time.\n- `src/bots.js` — deterministic local bot inputs.\n- `src/main.js` — canvas renderer, HUD, input, and local demo shell.\n- `styles.css` / `index.html` — HUD layout and entry point.\n\n## Integration\n\n`Game#contribute(teamId, { hp, ammo, dashSeconds })` is the host hook for the\nghost minigames. Contributions are additive, non-negative, and shared by the\nwhole team. `Game#snapshot()` exposes state for a future network adapter.\n\n## Known limits\n\n- This is a local single-player prototype with bots; the authoritative\n  multiplayer server, city sharding, and lobby are not implemented yet.\n- The minigame apps are not embedded in the main game yet; `contribute()` is the\n  narrow bridge they will use.\n",
  "path": "/home/rabamari/Projects/netshoot/main-game/README.md"
}

286:   return next
287:     ? `Pot #${pot.id} — ready, next process ${next.order} at ${stationMeta.get(next.stationId).short}`
288:     : `Pot #${pot.id} — ready for the bottler`;
289: }
290: 
291: function isDraggable(pot) {
292:   return pot.location === 'intake' || pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY;
293: }
294: 
295: function meterDetails(pot) {
296:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
297:     const process = processByIndex[pot.stepIndex];
298:     return {
299:       ratio: process ? Math.min(1, pot.progressMs / process.durationMs) : 0,
300:       color: '#96d05c',
301:       mode: 'working',
302:     };
303:   }
304: 
305:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING) {
306:     return {
307:       ratio: Math.min(1, pot.progressMs / core.config.bottlingMs),
308:       color: '#f2c94c',
309:       mode: 'bottling',
310:     };
311:   }
312: 
313:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY) {
314:     const process = processByIndex[Math.max(0, pot.stepIndex - 1)];
315:     const ratio = process
316:       ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pot.windowMsLeft / process.windowMs))
317:       : 0;
318: 
319:     return {
320:       ratio,
321:       color: ratio <= 0.25 ? '#d64545' : ratio <= 0.5 ? '#dd9d34' : '#f2c94c',
322:       mode: 'ready',
323:     };
324:   }
325: 
326:   return { ratio: 0, color: '#96d05c', mode: 'idle' };
327: }
328: 
329: function setPotMeter(el, pot) {
330:   const meter = meterDetails(pot);
331:   el.style.setProperty('--meter', `${Math.round(meter.ratio * 100)}%`);
332:   el.style.setProperty('--meter-color', meter.color);
333:   el.classList.toggle(
334:     'is-warning',
335:     meter.mode === 'ready' && meter.ratio <= 0.5 && meter.ratio > 0.25,
336:   );
337:   el.classList.toggle(
338:     'is-urgent',
339:     meter.mode === 'ready' && meter.ratio <= 0.25,
340:   );
341: }
342: 
343: function createPotElement(pot) {
344:   const el = document.createElement('button');
345:   el.type = 'button';
346:   el.className = 'pot';
347:   el.dataset.potId = String(pot.id);
348:   el.title = potTitle(pot);
349:   el.setAttribute('aria-label', potTitle(pot));
350: 
351:   if (pot.location === 'intake') {
352:     el.classList.add('is-empty');
353:   }
354:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
355:     el.classList.add('is-working');
356:   }
357:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY) {
358:     el.classList.add('is-ready');
359:   }
360:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING) {
361:     el.classList.add('is-bottling');
362:   }
363:   if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.QUEUED) {
364:     el.classList.add('is-queued');
365:   }
366:   if (isDraggable(pot)) {
367:     el.classList.add('is-draggable');
368:   }
369: 
370:   el.style.setProperty('--fill', `${potFill(pot)}%`);
371:   el.style.setProperty('--liquid', potLiquid(pot));
372: 
373:   el.innerHTML = `
374:     <span class="pot__badge">${potBadge(pot)}</span>
375:     <span class="pot__lid"></span>
376:     <span class="pot__body"><span class="pot__liquid"></span></span>
377:     <span class="pot__meter"><span class="pot__meter-fill"></span></span>
378:   `;
379: 
380:   setPotMeter(el, pot);
381:   return el;
382: }
383: 
384: /* ---------- Render ---------- */
385: 
386: function renderHud() {
387:   const active = core.activePots;
388:   const ready = active.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY);
389:   const running = active.some(
390:     (pot) =>
391:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING ||
392:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
393:   );
394: 
395:   ui.emptiesCount.textContent = String(core.intakePots.length);
396:   ui.activeStat.textContent = String(active.length);
397:   ui.vialsStat.textContent = String(core.vialsProduced);
398:   ui.dashStat.textContent = `${core.secondsProduced}s`;
399:   ui.spoiledStat.textContent = String(core.potsSpoiled);
400:   ui.lamp.classList.toggle('is-ready', ready);
401:   ui.lamp.classList.toggle('is-run', !ready && running);
402: }
403: 
404: function renderIntake() {
405:   const pots = core.intakePots;
406:   ui.intakeRack.replaceChildren(...pots.map(createPotElement));
407:   ui.intakeRack.classList.toggle('is-empty', pots.length === 0);
408: }
409: 
410: function createSlots(pots, capacity) {
411:   const slots = [];
412: 
413:   for (let index = 0; index < capacity; index += 1) {
414:     const slot = document.createElement('div');
415:     slot.className = 'slot';
416:     if (pots[index]) {
417:       slot.classList.add('has-pot');
418:       slot.append(createPotElement(pots[index]));
419:     }
420:     slots.push(slot);
421:   }
422: 
423:   return slots;
424: }
425: 
426: function renderStations() {
427:   for (const station of core.stations) {
428:     const view = stationViews.get(station.id);
429:     const pots = core.getPotsAt(station.id);
430: 
431:     view.slots.replaceChildren(...createSlots(pots, view.capacity));
432:     view.count.textContent = `${pots.length} / ${view.capacity}`;
433:     view.card.classList.toggle(
434:       'has-ready',
435:       pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY),
436:     );
437:     view.card.classList.toggle(
438:       'is-working',
439:       pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING),
440:     );
441:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-full', pots.length >= view.capacity);
442:   }
443: 
444:   const bottler = stationViews.get('bottler');
445:   const pots = core.getPotsAt('bottler');
446:   bottler.slots.replaceChildren(...createSlots(pots, bottler.capacity));
447:   bottler.count.textContent = `${pots.length} / ${bottler.capacity}`;
448:   bottler.card.classList.toggle(
449:     'is-working',
450:     pots.some((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING),
451:   );
452:   bottler.card.classList.toggle('is-full', pots.length >= bottler.capacity);
453: }
454: 
455: function renderPlan() {
456:   const live = new Set();
457: 
458:   for (const pot of core.activePots) {
459:     if (pot.location === 'intake') {
460:       live.add(0);
461:     } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
462:       live.add(pot.stepIndex);
463:     } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY) {
464:       live.add(pot.stepIndex);
465:     }
466:   }
467: 
468:   planChips.forEach((chip, index) => {
469:     chip.classList.toggle('is-live', live.has(index));
470:   });
471: }
472: 
473: function stationLabel(id) {
474:   return stationViews.get(id)?.label ?? (id === 'bottler' ? 'BOTTLER' : id);
475: }
476: 
477: function nextDestination(pot) {
478:   if (pot.location === 'bottler') {
479:     return null;
480:   }
481: 
482:   let nextIndex;
483: 
484:   if (pot.location === 'intake') {
485:     nextIndex = 0;
486:   } else if (pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING) {
487:     nextIndex = pot.stepIndex + 1;
488:   } else {
489:     nextIndex = pot.stepIndex;
490:   }
491: 
492:   const nextProcess = processByIndex[nextIndex] ?? null;
493:   return {
494:     toId: nextProcess ? nextProcess.stationId : 'bottler',
495:     nextIndex,
496:     process: nextProcess,
497:   };
498: }
499: 
500: function renderHint() {
501:   const active = core.activePots;
502:   const ready = active.find((pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY);
503: 
504:   if (ready) {
505:     const destination = nextDestination(ready);
506:     const target = stationLabel(destination.toId);
507: 
508:     ui.hint.textContent =
509:       destination.toId === 'bottler'
510:         ? `Pot #${ready.id} is ready at ${stationLabel(
511:             ready.location,
512:           )} — drag it into the BOTTLER before the timer empties.`
513:         : `Pot #${ready.id} is ready at ${stationLabel(
514:             ready.location,
515:           )} — drag it to ${target} (process ${destination.process.order}) before the timer empties.`;
516:     return;
517:   }
518: 
519:   const bottling = active.find(
520:     (pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING,
521:   );
522:   if (bottling) {
523:     const waiting = active.filter(
524:       (pot) => pot.status === POT_STATUS.QUEUED,
525:     ).length;
526:     ui.hint.textContent = `Pot #${bottling.id} is emptying onto the vial belt — one pot at a time, ${core.config.bottlingMs / 1000} seconds each.${waiting > 0 ? ` ${waiting} pot${waiting === 1 ? '' : 's'} waiting.` : ''}`;
527:     return;
528:   }
529: 
530:   if (active.length === 0) {
531:     ui.hint.textContent =
532:       core.vialsProduced > 0
533:         ? `${core.vialsProduced} vials banked. Take another pot from the intake.`
534:         : 'Take empty pots from the top-left intake.';
535:     return;
536:   }
537: 
538:   if (active.every((pot) => pot.location === 'intake')) {
539:     ui.hint.textContent =
540:       'Drag an empty pot into the GRAIN MILL for process 1.';
541:     return;
542:   }
543: 
544:   ui.hint.textContent =
545:     'Stations work on their own. Keep every pot moving before its ready timer runs out.';
546: }
547: 
548: function render() {
549:   renderHud();
550:   renderPlan();
551:   renderIntake();
552:   renderStations();
553:   renderArrows();
554:   renderHint();
555: }
556: 
557: function updateLiveUi() {
558:   document.querySelectorAll('.pot[data-pot-id]').forEach((el) => {
559:     if (el.closest('.fx-layer') || el.classList.contains('drag-ghost')) {
560:       return;
561:     }
562: 
563:     const pot = findPot(Number(el.dataset.potId));
564:     if (!pot) {
565:       return;
566:     }
567: 
568:     el.style.setProperty('--fill', `${potFill(pot)}%`);
569:     setPotMeter(el, pot);
570:   });
571: }
572: 
573: /* ---------- Arrows ---------- */
574: 
575: function svgElement(name) {
576:   return document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', name);
577: }
578: 
579: function nodeRect(id, canvasRect) {
580:   const el = id === 'intake' ? ui.intake : stationViews.get(id)?.card;
581:   if (!el) {
582:     return null;
583:   }
584: 
585:   const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
586:   return {
587:     left: rect.left - canvasRect.left,
588:     top: rect.top - canvasRect.top,
589:     width: rect.width,
590:     height: rect.height,
591:   };
592: }
593: 
594: function centerOf(rect) {
595:   return {
596:     x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,
597:     y: rect.top + rect.height / 2,
598:   };
599: }
600: 
601: function edgePoint(rect, toward, pad = 7) {
602:   const center = centerOf(rect);
603:   const dx = toward.x - center.x;
604:   const dy = toward.y - center.y;
605:   const halfW = rect.width / 2 + pad;
606:   const halfH = rect.height / 2 + pad;
607: 
608:   if (dx === 0 && dy === 0) {
609:     return center;
610:   }
611: 
612:   const scaleX = dx === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfW / Math.abs(dx);
613:   const scaleY = dy === 0 ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : halfH / Math.abs(dy);
614:   const scale = Math.min(scaleX, scaleY);
615: 
616:   return {
617:     x: center.x + dx * scale,
618:     y: center.y + dy * scale,
619:   };
620: }
621: 
622: function renderArrows() {
623:   const canvasRect = ui.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
624:   const width = Math.max(1, Math.round(canvasRect.width));
625:   const height = Math.max(1, Math.round(canvasRect.height));
626: 
627:   ui.arrows.setAttribute('viewBox', `0 0 ${width} ${height}`);
628:   ui.arrows.replaceChildren();
629: 
630:   const defs = svgElement('defs');
631:   defs.innerHTML = `
632:     <marker id="arrow-dim" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
633:       markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
634:       <path d="M0 0 10 5 0 10z" fill="#6d6855"></path>
635:     </marker>
636:     <marker id="arrow-gold" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
637:       markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" orient="auto-start-reverse">
638:       <path d="M0 0 10 5 0 10z" fill="#f2c94c"></path>
639:     </marker>
640:   `;
641:   ui.arrows.append(defs);
642: 
643:   const groups = new Map();
644: 
645:   for (const pot of core.activePots) {
646:     const destination = nextDestination(pot);
647:     if (!destination || destination.toId === pot.location) {
648:       continue;
649:     }
650: 
651:     const key = `${pot.location}->${destination.toId}`;
652:     let group = groups.get(key);
653: 
654:     if (!group) {
655:       group = {
656:         fromId: pot.location,
657:         toId: destination.toId,
658:         orders: new Set(),
659:         ready: false,
660:         count: 0,
661:       };
662:       groups.set(key, group);
663:     }
664: 
665:     group.count += 1;
666:     group.ready =
667:       group.ready ||
668:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.READY ||
669:       pot.location === 'intake';
670:     group.orders.add(destination.process?.order ?? 'BTL');
671:   }
672: 
673:   if (groups.size === 0 && core.activePots.length === 0) {
674:     groups.set('intake->mill', {
675:       fromId: 'intake',
676:       toId: 'mill',
677:       orders: new Set([1]),
678:       ready: false,
679:       count: 0,
680:     });
681:   }
682: 
683:   for (const group of groups.values()) {
684:     const fromRect = nodeRect(group.fromId, canvasRect);
685:     const toRect = nodeRect(group.toId, canvasRect);
686: 
687:     if (!fromRect || !toRect) {
688:       continue;
689:     }
690: 
691:     const start = edgePoint(fromRect, centerOf(toRect));
692:     const end = edgePoint(toRect, centerOf(fromRect));
693:     const dx = end.x - start.x;
694:     const dy = end.y - start.y;
695:     const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
696:     const fromIndex = FLOW_INDEX[group.fromId] ?? 0;
697:     const toIndex = FLOW_INDEX[group.toId] ?? 0;
698:     const direction = fromIndex <= toIndex ? 1 : -1;
699:     const bend = Math.min(54, distance * 0.15) * direction;
700:     const normalX = -dy / distance;
701:     const normalY = dx / distance;
702:     const controlX = (start.x + end.x) / 2 + normalX * bend;
703:     const controlY = (start.y + end.y) / 2 + normalY * bend;
704: 
705:     const path = svgElement('path');
706:     path.setAttribute(
707:       'd',
708:       `M ${start.x} ${start.y} Q ${controlX} ${controlY} ${end.x} ${end.y}`,
709:     );
710:     path.setAttribute(
711:       'class',
712:       `arrow ${group.ready ? 'arrow--ready' : 'arrow--waiting'}`,
713:     );
714:     path.setAttribute(
715:       'marker-end',
716:       group.ready ? 'url(#arrow-gold)' : 'url(#arrow-dim)',
717:     );
718:     ui.arrows.append(path);
719: 
720:     const label = svgElement('text');
721:     label.setAttribute('x', String(0.25 * start.x + 0.5 * controlX + 0.25 * end.x));
722:     label.setAttribute('y', String(0.25 * start.y + 0.5 * controlY + 0.25 * end.y));
723:     label.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'middle');
724:     label.setAttribute('dominant-baseline', 'middle');
725:     label.setAttribute(
726:       'class',
727:       `arrow__label${group.ready ? ' arrow__label--ready' : ''}`,
728:     );
729:     label.textContent = [...group.orders].join('·');
730:     ui.arrows.append(label);
731:   }
732: }
733: 
734: /* ---------- Drag and drop ---------- */
735: 
736: function updateDragCards() {
737:   const expected = drag ? nextDestination(findPot(drag.potId))?.toId : null;
738: 
739:   for (const [id, view] of stationViews) {
740:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-valid-target', id === expected);
741:     view.card.classList.remove('is-drop-invalid');
742:   }
743: }
744: 
745: function targetUnderPointer(clientX, clientY) {
746:   const el = document.elementFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
747:   const card = el?.closest('.station');
748:   const id = card?.dataset.stationId;
749: 
750:   return id && stationViews.has(id) ? id : null;
751: }
752: 
753: function moveGhost(clientX, clientY) {
754:   if (!drag) {
755:     return;
756:   }
757:   drag.ghost.style.left = `${clientX - drag.offsetX}px`;
758:   drag.ghost.style.top = `${clientY - drag.offsetY}px`;
759: }
760: 
761: function onPointerMove(event) {
762:   if (!drag) {
763:     return;
764:   }
765: 
766:   moveGhost(event.clientX, event.clientY);
767:   const targetId = targetUnderPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY);
768: 
769:   if (targetId === drag.hoverId) {
770:     return;
771:   }
772: 
773:   drag.hoverId = targetId;
774: 
775:   for (const [id, view] of stationViews) {
776:     view.card.classList.toggle('is-drop-hover', id === targetId);
777:     view.card.classList.toggle(
778:       'is-drop-invalid',
779:       id === targetId && id !== drag.expectedId,
780:     );
781:   }
782: }
783: 
784: function cleanupDrag() {
785:   if (!drag) {
786:     return;
787:   }
788: 
789:   drag.ghost.remove();
790:   drag.originEl?.classList.remove('is-dragging-source');
791:   document.body.classList.remove('is-dragging');
792: 
793:   for (const view of stationViews.values()) {
794:     view.card.classList.remove(
795:       'is-valid-target',
796:       'is-drop-hover',
797:       'is-drop-invalid',
798:     );
799:   }
800: 
801:   window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
802:   window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
803:   window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
804:   drag = null;
805: }
806: 
807: function onPointerUp(event) {
808:   if (!drag) {
809:     return;
810:   }
811: 
812:   const potId = drag.potId;
813:   const targetId = targetUnderPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY);
814: 
815:   cleanupDrag();
816: 
817:   if (targetId) {
818:     const eventResult = core.dropPot(potId, targetId);
819: 
820:     if (eventResult.type === 'rejected') {
821:       toast(rejectionText(eventResult));
822:     }
823:   }
824: 
825:   render();
826: }
827: 
828: function onPointerCancel() {
829:   cleanupDrag();
830:   render();
831: }
832: 
833: function onPointerDown(event) {
834:   if (event.button !== 0) {
835:     return;
836:   }
837: 
838:   const potEl = event.target.closest('.pot');
839:   if (!potEl || potEl.closest('.fx-layer')) {
840:     return;
841:   }
842: 
843:   const pot = findPot(Number(potEl.dataset.potId));
844:   if (!pot) {
845:     return;
846:   }
847: 
848:   if (!isDraggable(pot)) {
849:     if (
850:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.WORKING ||
851:       pot.status === POT_STATUS.BOTTLING
852:     ) {
853:       toast(`Pot #${pot.id} is still working.`);
854:     }
855:     return;
856:   }
857: 
858:   event.preventDefault();
859: 
860:   const rect = potEl.getBoundingClientRect();
861:   const ghost = potEl.cloneNode(true);
862:   ghost.classList.remove('is-working', 'is-ready', 'is-urgent', 'is-warning');
863:   ghost.classList.add('drag-ghost');
864:   ghost.style.left = `${rect.left}px`;
865:   ghost.style.top = `${rect.top}px`;
866:   ghost.style.width = `${rect.width}px`;
867:   ghost.style.height = `${rect.height}px`;
868:   ghost.tabIndex = -1;
869:   ui.fx.append(ghost);
870: 
871:   potEl.classList.add('is-dragging-source');
872: 
873:   drag = {
874:     potId: pot.id,
875:     ghost,
876:     originEl: potEl,
877:     offsetX: event.clientX - rect.left,
878:     offsetY: event.clientY - rect.top,
879:     expectedId: nextDestination(pot)?.toId ?? null,
880:     hoverId: null,
881:   };
882: 
883:   document.body.classList.add('is-dragging');
884:   updateDragCards();
885: 
886:   window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
887:   window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
888:   window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerCancel);
889: }
890: 
891: /* ---------- Events, FX, and hints ---------- */
892: 
893: function stationName(id) {
894:   return id === 'bottler' ? 'BOTTLER' : stationMeta.get(id)?.name ?? id;
895: }
896: 
897: function rejectionText(event) {
898:   switch (event.reason) {
899:     case 'wrong-station':
900:       return `Wrong station — that pot needs ${stationName(
901:         event.expectedStationId,
902:       )} for process ${event.process?.order}.`;
903:     case 'pot-busy':
904:       return 'That pot is still being processed.';
905:     case 'station-full':
906:       return 'That station already holds four pots.';
907:     case 'bottler-full':
908:       return 'The bottler is full. Wait for a pot to finish.';
909:     case 'processes-remaining':
910:       return `That pot still needs process ${event.process?.order} at ${stationName(
911:         event.process?.stationId,
912:       )}.`;
913:     case 'ready-for-bottler':
914:       return 'All twelve processes are done — drop it in the bottler.';
915:     case 'already-there':
916:       return 'That pot is already at this station.';
917:     case 'pot-gone':
918:       return 'That pot has already left the line.';
919:     case 'unknown-station':
920:       return 'That is not a station.';
921:     case 'unknown-pot':
922:       return 'Unknown pot.';
923:     default:
924:       return 'That move is not possible right now.';
925:   }
926: }
927: 
928: function toast(message) {
929:   ui.toast.textContent = message;
930:   ui.toast.classList.add('is-visible');

202: /**
203:  * Pure management rules for the Dash Supplement Factory.
204:  *
205:  * The player takes empty pots from an unlimited intake, drags each one into the
206:  * station for its current numbered process, and moves it on before the ready
207:  * window expires. Stations process four pots at once. After all twelve
208:  * processes, a pot goes to the bottler and produces 20 one-second vials.
209:  *
210:  * The core has no DOM or wall clock. The host reports elapsed time with
211:  * `advance(deltaMs)` and receives every completion, spoil, and bottling event.
212:  */
213: export class DashSupplementFactory {
214:   constructor({ config = {} } = {}) {
215:     this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
216:     validateConfig(this.config);

218:     this.stations = this.config.stations.map((station) => ({ ...station }));
219:     this.processes = this.config.processes

223:     this._pots = [];

233:   }

236:     return this._pots
237:       .filter((pot) => pot.location !== 'exited')
238:       .map((pot) => ({ ...pot }));
239:   }
240: 
241:   get intakePots() {
242:     return this.#potsAt('intake');
243:   }
244: 
245:   get elapsedMs() {
246:     return this._elapsedMs;
247:   }
248: 
249:   get vialsProduced() {
250:     return this._vialsProduced;
251:   }
252: 
253:   get secondsProduced() {
254:     return this._vialsProduced * this.config.secondsPerVial;
255:   }
256: 
257:   get potsBottled() {

278:   /** Number of occupied slots per station, plus the bottler. */

282:     for (const station of this.stations) {

287:     return result;

300:   /** Add one empty pot to the intake. There is no limit. */

307:       progressMs: 0,

37: /** Small, fast, deterministic 32-bit PRNG. */
38: export function mulberry32(seed) {
39:   let state = seed >>> 0;
40:   return function next() {
41:     state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
42:     let t = state;
43:     t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
44:     t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
45:     return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
46:   };
47: }

49: export function makeRng(seed) {
50:   const next = mulberry32(seed);
51:   return {
52:     next,
53:     int(max) {
54:       return Math.floor(next() * max);
55:     },
56:     pick(list) {
57:       return list[this.int(list.length)];
58:     },
59:     shuffle(list) {
60:       for (let index = list.length - 1; index > 0; index -= 1) {
61:         const swap = this.int(index + 1);
62:         [list[index], list[swap]] = [list[swap], list[index]];
63:       }
64:       return list;
65:     },

176: function placeSpawnZones(rng, width, height, teams, playersPerTeam) {

function connectRooms(tiles, width, height, from, to) {
  const fromX = from.x + Math.floor(from.width / 2);
  const fromY = from.y + Math.floor(from.height / 2);
  const toX = to.x + Math.floor(to.width / 2);

  const x2 = Math.max(fromX, col) + 1;
  const y1 = Math.min(toY, row);

  carveHorizontal(tiles, width, x1, x2, row, row + 1);
  carveVertical(tiles, width, y1, y2, col, col + 1);
}

The horizontal arm spans the source room to\n  // the destination column band, the vertical arm spans the horizontal band to\n  // the destination room, and the overlap is a 2x2 corner.\n  const row = bandStart(fromY, height);\n  const column = bandStart(toX, width);\n  const left = Math.min(fromX, column);\n  const right = Math.max(fromX, column) + 1;\n  const top = Math.min(row, toY);\n  const bottom = Math.max(row + 1, toY);\n\n  carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, top, right, bottom);\n}\n\nfunction carveRectangle(tiles, width, left, top, right, bottom) {\n  for (let y = top; y <= bottom; y += 1) {\n    for (let x = left; x <= right; x += 1) {\n      tiles[y * width + x] = TILE.FREE;\n    }\n  }\n}"
