284:       }
285:       case 'special-used': {
286:         const meta = ITEM_META[event.type];
287:         toast(`${meta.name} TRIGGERED FOR THE TEAM`, 'good');
288:         break;
289:       }
290:       case 'team-downed': {
291:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
292:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
293:           toast('TEAM DOWN — HALF WILL RETURN', 'bad');
294:         } else {
295:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} DOWN`, 'good');
296:         }
297:         break;
298:       }
299:       case 'team-revived': {
300:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
301:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
302:           toast(`REVIVED ${event.living} COMRADES — ${event.hp} HP`, 'good');
303:         } else {
304:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} REVIVED ${event.living}`, 'bad');
305:         }
306:         break;
307:       }
308:       case 'team-eliminated': {
309:         const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
310:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
311:           showBanner('ELIMINATED', 'Press R for a new match');
312:         } else {
313:           toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} ELIMINATED`, 'good');
314:         }
315:         break;
316:       }
317:       case 'effect-ended':
318:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
319:           toast(`${EFFECT_NAMES[event.effect] ?? event.effect} EXPIRED`);
320:         }
321:         break;
322:       case 'damage-blocked':
323:         if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
324:           toast('+COAT ABSORBED THE HIT', 'good');
325:         }
326:         break;
327:       case 'ghost-task':
328:         if (event.playerId === me.id) {
329:           toast(`GHOST TASK — ${TASK_NAMES[event.task] ?? event.task}`, 'good');
330:         }
331:         break;
332:       case 'match-over': {
333:         const won = event.winnerTeamId === me.teamId;
334:         showBanner(
335:           won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT',
336:           won ? 'LAST TEAM STANDING' : `${game.teams[event.winnerTeamId].name.toUpperCase()} HOLDS THE MAZE`,
337:           won ? 'good' : 'bad',
338:         );
339:         break;
340:       }
341:       default:
342:         break;
343:     }
344:   }
345: }
346: 
347: function showBanner(title, text, tone = 'bad') {
348:   ui.bannerTitle.textContent = title;
349:   ui.bannerText.textContent = text;
350:   ui.banner.className = `banner${tone === 'good' ? ' is-good' : ''}`;
351:   ui.banner.hidden = false;
352: }
353: 
354: function toast(message, tone = '') {
355:   const element = document.createElement('div');
356:   element.className = `toast${tone ? ` is-${tone}` : ''}`;
357:   element.textContent = message;
358:   ui.toasts.append(element);
359: 
360:   while (ui.toasts.children.length > 4) {
361:     ui.toasts.firstElementChild.remove();
362:   }
363: 
364:   window.setTimeout(() => element.remove(), 2600);
365: }
366: 
367: /* ---------- Render ---------- */
368: 
369: function render(now) {
370:   ctx.clearRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
371:   ctx.fillStyle = '#070605';
372:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
373: 
374:   drawTiles();
375:   drawSpawnZones();
376:   drawRoute();
377:   drawItems(now);
378:   drawBombs(now);
379:   drawBullets();
380:   drawPlayers(now);
381:   drawEffects();
382:   drawCrosshair();
383: 
384:   if (game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
385:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6, 4, 4, 0.45)';
386:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, viewWidth, viewHeight);
387:   }
388: }
389: 
390: function drawTiles() {
391:   const halfWidth = viewWidth / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
392:   const halfHeight = viewHeight / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
393:   const minX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.x - halfWidth));
394:   const maxX = Math.min(game.maze.width - 1, Math.ceil(camera.x + halfWidth));
395:   const minY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.y - halfHeight));
396:   const maxY = Math.min(game.maze.height - 1, Math.ceil(camera.y + halfHeight));
397: 
398:   const wallShades = ['#3b3328', '#352e24', '#41382b'];
399: 
400:   for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y += 1) {
401:     for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += 1) {
402:       const [screenX, screenY] = worldToScreen(x, y);
403:       const wall = game.maze.tiles[y * game.maze.width + x] === TILE.WALL;
404: 
405:       if (wall) {
406:         const shade = wallShades[(x * 31 + y * 17) % wallShades.length];
407:         ctx.fillStyle = shade;
408:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
409:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28)';
410:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 5, TILE_PX + 0.5, 5);
411:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
412:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, 2);
413:       } else {
414:         ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? '#0d0b09' : '#0b0a08';
415:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
416:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018)';
417:         ctx.fillRect(screenX + TILE_PX - 1, screenY, 1, TILE_PX);
418:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 1, TILE_PX, 1);
419:       }
420: 
421:       const owner = spawnTeamAt(game.maze, x, y);
422:       if (owner >= 0 && !wall) {
423:         ctx.fillStyle = withAlpha(game.teams[owner].color, 0.07);
424:         ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
425:       }
426:     }
427:   }
428: }
429: 
430: function drawSpawnZones() {
431:   for (const spawn of game.maze.spawns) {
432:     const team = game.teams[spawn.teamId];
433:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(spawn.x, spawn.y);
434:     ctx.strokeStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.45);
435:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
436:     ctx.setLineDash([8, 6]);
437:     ctx.strokeRect(x, y, spawn.width * TILE_PX, spawn.height * TILE_PX);
438:     ctx.setLineDash([]);
439: 
440:     ctx.fillStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.6);
441:     ctx.font = '700 9px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
442:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
443:     ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
444:     ctx.fillText(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} SPAWN`, x + 3, y - 4);
445:   }
446: }
447: 
448: function drawRoute() {
449:   if (
450:     MINIMAP_MODES[minimapModeIndex] !== 'COMRATS' ||
451:     routeTargetId === null ||
452:     routeTargetId === me.id ||
453:     routePath.length < 2
454:   ) {
455:     return;
456:   }
457: 
458:   ctx.save();
459:   ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.72)';
460:   ctx.lineWidth = 2;
461:   ctx.setLineDash([7, 7]);
462:   ctx.beginPath();
463: 
464:   routePath.forEach((point, index) => {
465:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(point.x, point.y);
466:     if (index === 0) {
467:       ctx.moveTo(x, y);
468:     } else {
469:       ctx.lineTo(x, y);
470:     }
471:   });
472: 
473:   ctx.stroke();
474:   ctx.setLineDash([]);
475: 
476:   const target = game.playersById.get(routeTargetId);
477:   if (target) {
478:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(target.x, target.y);
479:     ctx.beginPath();
480:     ctx.arc(x, y, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2);
481:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.8)';
482:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
483:     ctx.stroke();
484:   }
485: 
486:   ctx.restore();
487: }
488: 
489: function drawItems(now) {
490:   const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(now / 240) * 0.08;
491: 
492:   for (const item of game.maze.items) {
493:     if (item.taken) {
494:       continue;
495:     }
496: 
497:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(item.x + 0.5, item.y + 0.5);
498:     if (x < -40 || y < -40 || x > viewWidth + 40 || y > viewHeight + 40) {
499:       continue;
500:     }
501: 
502:     const meta = ITEM_META[item.type];
503:     ctx.save();
504:     ctx.translate(x, y);
505:     ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
506:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.85)';
507:     ctx.strokeStyle = meta.color;
508:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
509:     ctx.beginPath();
510:     ctx.roundRect(-9, -9, 18, 18, 3);
511:     ctx.fill();
512:     ctx.stroke();
513:     ctx.fillStyle = meta.color;
514:     ctx.font = '700 10px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
515:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
516:     ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
517:     ctx.fillText(meta.label, 0, 0.5);
518:     ctx.restore();
519:   }
520: }
521: 
522: function drawBombs(now) {
523:   for (const bomb of game.bombs) {
524:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(bomb.x, bomb.y);
525:     const flicker = 0.6 + Math.sin(now / 60) * 0.4;
526:     ctx.beginPath();
527:     ctx.arc(x, y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
528:     ctx.fillStyle = '#2a0f0f';
529:     ctx.fill();
530:     ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 90, 80, ${flicker})`;
531:     ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
532:     ctx.stroke();
533:     ctx.beginPath();
534:     ctx.arc(x + 4, y - 7, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
535:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f2c94c';
536:     ctx.fill();
537:   }
538: }
539: 
540: function drawBullets() {
541:   ctx.lineCap = 'round';
542: 
543:   for (const bullet of game.bullets) {
544:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(bullet.x, bullet.y);
545:     const length = Math.hypot(bullet.vx, bullet.vy) || 1;
546:     const trailX = (bullet.vx / length) * 10;
547:     const trailY = (bullet.vy / length) * 10;
548: 
549:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8e7ab';
550:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
551:     ctx.beginPath();
552:     ctx.moveTo(x, y);
553:     ctx.lineTo(x - trailX, y - trailY);
554:     ctx.stroke();
555: 
556:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.25)';
557:     ctx.lineWidth = 5;
558:     ctx.beginPath();
559:     ctx.moveTo(x, y);
560:     ctx.lineTo(x - trailX, y - trailY);
561:     ctx.stroke();
562:   }
563: 
564:   ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
565: }
566: 
567: function drawPlayers(now) {
568:   for (const player of game.players) {
569:     const team = game.teams[player.teamId];
570:     const [x, y] = worldToScreen(player.x, player.y);
571:     const radius = PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX;
572:     const isMe = player.id === me.id;
573: 
574:     ctx.save();
575:     ctx.globalAlpha = player.alive ? 1 : 0.4;
576: 
577:     if (!player.alive) {
578:       ctx.strokeStyle = withAlpha(team.color, 0.8);
579:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
580:       ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
581:       ctx.beginPath();
582:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius + 4 + Math.sin(now / 300 + player.id) * 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
583:       ctx.stroke();
584:       ctx.setLineDash([]);
585:     }
586: 
587:     // Gun barrel
588:     const gunLength = radius * 1.7;
589:     const gunX = Math.cos(player.angle);
590:     const gunY = Math.sin(player.angle);
591:     const perpX = -gunY;
592:     const perpY = gunX;
593:     ctx.beginPath();
594:     ctx.moveTo(x + gunX * gunLength, y + gunY * gunLength);
595:     ctx.lineTo(x + perpX * 3, y + perpY * 3);
596:     ctx.lineTo(x - perpX * 3, y - perpY * 3);
597:     ctx.closePath();
598:     ctx.fillStyle = player.alive ? '#e9dfc5' : withAlpha('#e9dfc5', 0.5);
599:     ctx.fill();
600: 
601:     // Body
602:     ctx.beginPath();
603:     ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
604:     ctx.fillStyle = team.color;
605:     ctx.fill();
606:     ctx.lineWidth = isMe ? 2.5 : 1.5;
607:     ctx.strokeStyle = isMe ? '#ffffff' : '#100d09';
608:     ctx.stroke();
609: 
610:     if (isMe) {
611:       ctx.beginPath();
612:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
613:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.7)';
614:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
615:       ctx.setLineDash([2, 4]);
616:       ctx.stroke();
617:       ctx.setLineDash([]);
618:     }
619: 
620:     if (player.teamId === me.teamId) {
621:       ctx.globalAlpha = player.alive ? 0.85 : 0.5;
622:       ctx.fillStyle = '#d7cfb9';
623:       ctx.font = '700 7.5px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
624:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
625:       ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
626:       ctx.fillText(isMe ? 'YOU' : player.name.toUpperCase(), x, y - radius - 5);
627:     }
628: 
629:     ctx.restore();
630:   }
631: }
632: 
633: function drawEffects() {
634:   for (const effect of effects) {
635:     const progress = 1 - effect.life / effect.total;
636: 
637:     if (effect.type === 'blast') {
638:       const [x, y] = worldToScreen(effect.x, effect.y);
639:       const radius = effect.radius * TILE_PX * progress;
640:       ctx.beginPath();
641:       ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
642:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(242, 120, 60, ${0.28 * (1 - progress)})`;
643:       ctx.fill();
644:       ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 210, 140, ${0.8 * (1 - progress)})`;
645:       ctx.lineWidth = 3;
646:       ctx.stroke();
647:     } else if (effect.type === 'flash') {
648:       const player = game.playersById.get(effect.playerId);
649:       if (!player) {
650:         continue;
651:       }
652:       const [x, y] = worldToScreen(player.x, player.y);
653:       const muzzleX = x + Math.cos(player.angle) * PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX * 1.9;
654:       const muzzleY = y + Math.sin(player.angle) * PLAYER_RADIUS * TILE_PX * 1.9;
655:       ctx.beginPath();
656:       ctx.arc(muzzleX, muzzleY, 5 * (1 - progress) + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
657:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 236, 160, ${1 - progress})`;
658:       ctx.fill();
659:     }
660:   }
661: }
662: 
663: function drawCrosshair() {
664:   ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(242, 201, 76, 0.55)';
665:   ctx.lineWidth = 1;
666:   ctx.beginPath();
667:   ctx.arc(mouse.x, mouse.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
668:   ctx.stroke();
669:   ctx.beginPath();
670:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x - 11, mouse.y);
671:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x - 3, mouse.y);
672:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x + 3, mouse.y);
673:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x + 11, mouse.y);
674:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 11);
675:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y - 3);
676:   ctx.moveTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 3);
677:   ctx.lineTo(mouse.x, mouse.y + 11);
678:   ctx.stroke();
679: }
680: 
681: /* ---------- HUD ---------- */
682: 
683: function updateHud(now, delta) {
684:   updateEffects(delta);
685: 
686:   if (now >= hudNext) {
687:     hudNext = now + 120;
688:     updateStats();
689:     updateReserves();
690:     updateHealth();
691:     updateMinimap();
692:   }
693: 
694:   if (now >= comratsNext) {
695:     comratsNext = now + 260;
696:     updateComrats();
697:   }
698: }
699: 
700: function updateEffects(delta) {
701:   effects = effects.filter((effect) => {
702:     effect.life -= delta;
703:     return effect.life > 0;
704:   });
705: }
706: 
707: function updateStats() {
708:   ui.stats.fps.textContent = `FPS ${Math.round(fps)}`;
709:   ui.stats.fps.className = `stat ${fps >= 50 ? '' : fps >= 30 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;
710: 
711:   ui.stats.frame.textContent = `${frameMs.toFixed(1)} ms`;
712:   ui.stats.frame.className = `stat ${frameMs <= 20 ? '' : frameMs <= 33 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;
713: 
714:   ui.stats.conn.textContent = 'LOCAL';
715:   ui.stats.conn.className = 'stat is-dim';
716: 
717:   const aliveA = game.teams[0].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(0);
718:   const aliveB = game.teams[1].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(1);
719:   ui.stats.alive.textContent = `${aliveA} / ${aliveB}`;
720:   ui.stats.alive.className = 'stat is-dim';
721: }
722: 
723: function countAlive(teamId) {
724:   return game.players.filter((player) => player.teamId === teamId && player.alive).length;
725: }
726: 
727: function updateReserves() {
728:   const team = game.teams[me.teamId];
729:   ui.teamName.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
730:   ui.ammo.textContent = String(team.ammo);
731:   ui.dash.textContent = `${Math.floor(team.dashSeconds)}s`;
732:   ui.special.textContent = team.specials.length
733:     ? ITEM_META[team.specials[team.specials.length - 1]].name
734:     : '—';
735: 
736:   const queue = team.specials.map((type, index) => {
737:     const span = document.createElement('span');
738:     const current = index === team.specials.length - 1;
739:     span.textContent = ITEM_META[type].name;
740:     if (current) {
741:       span.className = 'is-current';
742:     }
743:     return span;
744:   });
745:   ui.specialQueue.replaceChildren(...queue);
746: }
747: 
748: function updateHealth() {
749:   const team = game.teams[me.teamId];
750:   const maxHp = Math.max(1, team.maxHp);
751:   const ratio = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, team.hp / maxHp));
752: 
753:   ui.healthTeam.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
754:   ui.hpLabel.textContent = `${Math.round(team.hp)} / ${Math.round(team.maxHp)}`;
755:   ui.hpFill.style.width = `${ratio * 100}%`;
756:   ui.hpFill.className = `health__fill${
757:     ratio <= 0.34 ? ' is-low' : ratio <= 0.67 ? ' is-mid' : ''
758:   }`;
759: 
760:   if (team.activeEffect) {
761:     const seconds = Math.max(0, team.activeEffect.msLeft / 1000);
762:     ui.effectLabel.textContent = `${EFFECT_NAMES[team.activeEffect.type] ?? team.activeEffect.type} ${seconds.toFixed(0)}s`;
763:   } else {
764:     ui.effectLabel.textContent = 'NO EFFECT';
765:   }
766: 
767:   if (game.winnerTeamId !== null) {
768:     const won = game.winnerTeamId === me.teamId;
769:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT';
770:     showBanner(
771:       won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT',
772:       won ? 'LAST TEAM STANDING' : `${game.teams[game.winnerTeamId].name.toUpperCase()} HOLDS THE MAZE`,
773:       won ? 'good' : 'bad',
774:     );
775:   } else if (team.eliminated) {
776:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = 'ELIMINATED';
777:     showBanner('ELIMINATED', 'Press R for a new match');
778:   } else if (!me.alive) {
779:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = `GHOST · ${TASK_NAMES[me.ghostTask] ?? 'CLICKER'}`;
780:     ui.banner.hidden = true;
781:   } else {
782:     ui.statusLabel.textContent = 'LIVE';
783:     ui.banner.hidden = true;
784:   }
785: }
786: 
787: function updateComrats() {
788:   const teamPlayers = game.players
789:     .filter((player) => player.teamId === me.teamId)
790:     .sort((a, b) => Number(b.alive) - Number(a.alive) || a.id - b.id);
791: 
792:   const rows = teamPlayers.map((player) => {
793:     const item = document.createElement('li');
794:     if (player.id === me.id) {
795:       item.className = 'is-me';
796:     } else if (!player.alive) {
797:       item.className = 'is-dead';
798:     }
799: 
800:     const name = document.createElement('span');
801:     name.textContent = player.id === me.id ? 'YOU' : player.name.toUpperCase();
802: 
803:     const state = document.createElement('span');
804:     state.className = `comrat__state ${
805:       !player.alive ? 'is-ghost' : 'is-live'
806:     }`;
807:     state.textContent = player.alive ? 'LIVE' : 'GHOST';
808: 
809:     item.append(name, state);
810:     return item;
811:   });
812: 
813:   if (game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
814:     const item = document.createElement('li');
815:     item.className = 'is-dead';
816:     const name = document.createElement('span');
817:     name.textContent = 'TEAM ELIMINATED';
818:     item.append(name);
819:     rows.unshift(item);
820:   }
821: 
822:   ui.comrats.replaceChildren(...rows);
823:   ui.comratsCount.textContent = `${countAlive(me.teamId)} LIVE`;
824: }
825: 
826: function updateMinimap() {
827:   ui.minimapMode.textContent = MINIMAP_MODES[minimapModeIndex];
828:   const size = MINIMAP_SIZE;
829:   minimapCtx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
830: 
831:   if (!mazeBitmap) {
832:     return;
833:   }
834: 
835:   const mode = MINIMAP_MODES[minimapModeIndex];
836: 
837:   if (mode === 'COMRATS') {
838:     refreshRoute();
839:     drawTeamMap();
840:     return;
841:   }
842: 
843:   let sourceX = 0;
844:   let sourceY = 0;
845:   let sourceWidth = game.maze.width;
846:   let sourceHeight = game.maze.height;
847: 
848:   if (mode === 'NEARBY') {
849:     const span = 25;
850:     sourceWidth = span;
851:     sourceHeight = span;
852:     sourceX = clamp(me.x - span / 2, 0, game.maze.width - span);

136: function validateConfig(config) {
137:   const stationIds = new Set();
138: 
139:   if (!Array.isArray(config.stations) || config.stations.length < 1) {
140:     throw new RangeError('stations must contain at least one station');
141:   }
142: 
143:   for (const station of config.stations) {
144:     if (!station || typeof station.id !== 'string' || station.id.length === 0) {
145:       throw new RangeError('every station needs a non-empty id');
146:     }
147:     if (stationIds.has(station.id)) {
148:       throw new RangeError(`duplicate station: ${station.id}`);
149:     }
150:     stationIds.add(station.id);
151:   }
152: 
153:   if (!Array.isArray(config.processes) || config.processes.length < 1) {
154:     throw new RangeError('processes must contain at least one process');
155:   }
156: 
157:   const processIds = new Set();
158:   const orders = new Set();
159: 
160:   for (const process of config.processes) {
161:     if (!process || typeof process.id !== 'string' || process.id.length === 0) {
162:       throw new RangeError('every process needs a non-empty id');
163:     }
164:     if (processIds.has(process.id)) {
165:       throw new RangeError(`duplicate process: ${process.id}`);
166:     }
167:     processIds.add(process.id);
168: 
169:     if (!Number.isInteger(process.order) || process.order < 1) {
170:       throw new RangeError(`process ${process.id} needs a positive integer order`);
171:     }
172:     if (orders.has(process.order)) {
173:       throw new RangeError(`duplicate process order: ${process.order}`);
174:     }
175:     orders.add(process.order);
176: 
177:     if (!stationIds.has(process.stationId)) {
178:       throw new RangeError(`process ${process.id} uses an unknown station`);
179:     }
180:     if (!Number.isFinite(process.durationMs) || process.durationMs <= 0) {
181:       throw new RangeError(`process ${process.id} needs a positive durationMs`);
182:     }
183:     if (!Number.isFinite(process.windowMs) || process.windowMs <= 0) {
184:       throw new RangeError(`process ${process.id} needs a positive windowMs`);
185:     }
186:   }
187: 
188:   for (const key of ['stationCapacity', 'bottlerCapacity', 'vialsPerPot']) {
189:     if (!Number.isInteger(config[key]) || config[key] < 1) {
190:       throw new RangeError(`${key} must be a positive integer`);
191:     }
192:   }
193: 
194:   if (!Number.isFinite(config.secondsPerVial) || config.secondsPerVial <= 0) {
195:     throw new RangeError('secondsPerVial must be positive');
196:   }
197:   if (!Number.isFinite(config.bottlingMs) || config.bottlingMs <= 0) {
198:     throw new RangeError('bottlingMs must be positive');
199:   }

202: /**
203:  * Pure management rules for the Dash Supplement Factory.
204:  *
205:  * The player takes empty pots from an unlimited intake, drags each one into the
206:  * station for its current numbered process, and moves it on before the ready
207:  * window expires. Stations process four pots at once. After all twelve
208:  * processes, a pot goes to the bottler and produces 20 one-second vials.
209:  *
210:  * The core has no DOM or wall clock. The host reports elapsed time with
211:  * `advance(deltaMs)` and receives every completion, spoil, and bottling event.
212:  */

323:   /**

391:   /**

```
server.on('upgrade', (req, socket, head) => {

});
```

Bug in `WebSocketConnection.close`: sets `this.open=false` before `#closed()`, and `#closed()` returns if !open, so `onClose` never called on explicit close. The socket 'close' event later calls #closed but open already false → no callback. Need a separate `closedNotified` flag. Fix:
```
this.closedNotified=false;
close(){ if !open return; open=false; write; this.#notifyClosed(); }
#closed(){ if(this.closedNotified) return; this.open=false; this.closedNotified=true; this.onClose(); }
#notifyClosed same.
```
And on socket close event `#closed()`. Let's patch. Also `#closed` from socket 'close' should set open false.

Decoder applies `source[index]^key[index%4]`. That should work. But output `'}spl\x14'` suggests the decoder's mask offset is wrong by... Let's inspect encodeFrame: header length 2+lenbytes(1)=3? Wait `Buffer.alloc(1 + 1 + lengthBytes.length)`. For length <126, `lengthBytes = Buffer.from([length])`, lengthBytes.length=1. Header is 3 bytes: [0x81, 0x80|len, length]. Then `lengthBytes.copy(header, 2)` copies length byte again to header[2], overwriting? Header[1] already contains `0x80 | length`; then header[2] is the length. So header = [0x81, 0x80|len, len]. That's 3 bytes but standard header for masked short is 2 bytes + 4 mask. We added an extra byte! Because encodeLength returns the length byte(s) which should be placed at header[1], but we also set header[1]. Let's look:
```
const header = Buffer.alloc(1 + 1 + lengthBytes.length);
header[0]=fin|opcode;
header[1]=maskBit|lengthBytes[0];
lengthBytes.copy(header,2);
```
For short length, lengthBytes=[len], lengthBytes.length=1 → header size 3, header[1]=0x80|len, header[2]=len. Extra length byte. For 126, lengthBytes=3 bytes [126, hi, lo], header size 5, header[1]=0x80|126, then copy 3 bytes at offset2 → [126,hi,lo] → header = [0x81, 0xFE, 0x7E, hi, lo] extra 0x7E. Wrong.

Fix encode:
```
const bodyLength = body.length;
let ext;
if (bodyLength < 126) ext = Buffer.alloc(0);
else if (bodyLength < 65536) { ext=Buffer.alloc(2); ext.writeUInt16BE(...); }
else { ext=Buffer.alloc(8); ext.writeBigUInt64BE(...);}
const header = Buffer.alloc(2 + ext.length);
header[0]=...
header[1]=maskBit | (bodyLength<126 ? bodyLength : bodyLength<65536?126:127);
ext.copy(header,2);
```
Remove encodeLength or adapt. Let's patch.

State message to iframe:

Send on every `setState` if iframe loaded and contentWindow. Throttle? Called from applySnapshot at 20Hz. postMessage at 20Hz is fine.

Iframe load handling:
- On `load`, post `{type:'init', clientId}` then state.
- Parent listens:
  - `minigame-ready`: send state.
  - `contribute`: call onContribute({game, resources})
  - `factory-action`: call onFactoryAction
  - `pointer`: call onPointer
- The iframe source path should be absolute relative to parent page: `../soul-clicker/index.html?embed=1`. Since parent URL `/main-game/`, relative works.
- `select(task)`:
  - If task same and iframe loaded, no reload.
  - Set `this.task = task`; tab active classes; `panel.dataset.task = task`;
  - If `loadedTask !== task`, `frame.src = src + '?embed=1'`, loadedTask=task, frameLoaded=false.
  - call onTask(task).
  - Show panel.
- `show(task)` sets visible and selects.
- `hide()`.
- On close: hide but don't change task. onTask? Still ghost task server-side; fine.
- Title/status text.

Need parent to know `me` state. We'll call `ghostConsole.setState({...})` each snapshot.

Remote cursor: for dash factory, server pushes cursors in snapshot factory; the iframe renders.

```js
let pendingHp = 0;      // un-sent contribution
let lastTickMs = null;
let lastSendMs = 0;

function embedTick(nowMs) {
  if (!embedded) { clicker.advanceTo(nowMs); return; }
  if (lastTickMs === null) { lastTickMs = nowMs; return; }
  const dt = Math.max(0, (nowMs - lastTickMs) / 1000);
  lastTickMs = nowMs;
  if (dt <= 0) return;
  const rate = clicker.hpPerSecondAt(nowMs);
  pendingHp += rate * dt;
  if (nowMs - lastSendMs >= 1000) flushContribution(nowMs);
}

function flushContribution(nowMs) {
  if (Math.abs(pendingHp) < 0.001) { lastSendMs = nowMs; return; }
  embedPost({ type: 'contribute', game: 'soul-clicker', resources: { hp: pendingHp } });
  pendingHp = 0;
  lastSendMs = nowMs;
}
```

In embed mode:

- The iframe should render from remote state, not its own core.advance.
- Drag actions send `factory-action` messages (`take`, `drop`, `claim`, `release`) and wait for server snapshots.
- Pointer shows remote cursors + ownership.

The simplest approach: keep using `core` as a *view* by replacing its pots/state from the snapshot? The core has private `_pots`, `_elapsedMs`, etc. We could add a `hydrate(state)` method to the core that replaces internal state. That's a reasonable pure-core addition and testable. Then existing render functions work unchanged since they read `core.*`.

```js
/** Replace all mutable state from an authoritative snapshot (remote view). */
hydrate({ pots = [], elapsedMs = 0, vialsProduced = 0, potsBottled = 0, potsSpoiled = 0 } = {}) {
  this._pots = pots
    .filter((pot) => pot && pot.location !== 'exited')
    .map((pot) => ({
      id: pot.id,
      stepIndex: pot.stepIndex,
      location: pot.location,
      status: pot.status,
      progressMs: pot.progressMs,
      windowMsLeft: pot.windowMsLeft,
      spoiled: Boolean(pot.spoiled),
      bottled: Boolean(pot.bottled),
    }));
  this._elapsedMs = Math.max(0, Number(elapsedMs) || 0);
  this._vialsProduced = Math.max(0, Number(vialsProduced) || 0);
  this._potsBottled = Math.max(0, Number(potsBottled) || 0);
  this._potsSpoiled = Math.max(0, Number(potsSpoiled) || 0);
  const maxId = this._pots.reduce((max, pot) => Math.max(max, pot.id), 0);
  this._nextPotId = Math.max(this._nextPotId, maxId + 1);
  return this;
}
```

function buildMazeBitmap() {
  const { width, height, tiles, spawnZones } = game.maze;
  mazeBitmap = document.createElement('canvas');
  mazeBitmap.width = width;
  mazeBitmap.height = height;
  const bitmapCtx = mazeBitmap.getContext('2d');
  const image = bitmapCtx.createImageData(width, height);
  const data = image.data;
  const teamColors = game.teams.map((team) => hexToRgb(team.color));

  for (let index = 0; index < tiles.length; index += 1) {
    const offset = index * 4;
    const owner = spawnZones[index];

    if (tiles[index] === TILE.WALL) {
      data[offset] = 56;
      data[offset + 1] = 49;
      data[offset + 2] = 39;
    } else if (owner >= 0) {
      const color = teamColors[owner];
      data[offset] = Math.round(12 + color[0] * 0.32);
      data[offset + 1] = Math.round(10 + color[1] * 0.32);
      data[offset + 2] = Math.round(8 + color[2] * 0.32);
    } else {
      data[offset] = 14;
      data[offset + 1] = 12;
      data[offset + 2] = 10;
    }
    data[offset + 3] = 255;
  }

  bitmapCtx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
}
function drawItems(now) {
  const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(now / 240) * 0.08;

  for (const item of game.maze.items) {
    if (item.taken) {
      continue;
    }

    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(item.x + 0.5, item.y + 0.5);
    if (x < -40 || y < -40 || x > viewWidth + 40 || y > viewHeight + 40) {
      continue;
    }

    const meta = ITEM_META[item.type];
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(x, y);
    ctx.scale(pulse, pulse);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8, 6, 5, 0.85)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = meta.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(-9, -9, 18, 18, 3);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = meta.color;
    ctx.font = '700 10px "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(meta.label, 0, 0.5);
    ctx.restore();
  }
}

# commieD — Main Game Prototype

Local browser prototype of the commieD maze shooter. It runs a deterministic
game core with bots so the rules can be played and tested before authoritative
multiplayer exists.

## Run

```sh
cd main-game
python3 -m http.server 8000
```

Open `http://localhost:8000/`. No build step or dependencies are required.

## Test

```sh
cd main-game
npm test
```

The suite covers the three-pass maze generator, shared team resources, combat,
special items, ghost tasks, revival, elimination, and winner detection.

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `WASD` / arrows | Move |
| Mouse | Aim |
| Click / hold | Shoot |
| `Shift` | Dash |
| `Space` | Trigger the team special item |
| `X` | Cycle minimap: nearby → full maze → comrats |
| `↑` / `↓` in comrats | Select a teammate and draw a route |
| `1` / `2` / `3` | Ghost task: clicker / ammo / dash |
| `R` | New match |

## Structure

- `src/maze.js` — deterministic three-pass maze: spawn rooms, carved maze, items.
- `src/game.js` — pure rules: shared HP/ammo/dash, movement, combat, specials,
  ghosts, revival, elimination, winner. It does not read wall-clock time.
- `src/bots.js` — deterministic local bot inputs.
- `src/main.js` — canvas renderer, HUD, input, and local demo shell.
- `styles.css` / `index.html` — HUD layout and entry point.

## Integration

`Game#contribute(teamId, { hp, ammo, dashSeconds })` is the host hook for the
ghost minigames. Contributions are additive, non-negative, and shared by the
whole team. `Game#snapshot()` exposes state for a future network adapter.

## Known limits

- This is a local single-player prototype with bots; the authoritative
  multiplayer server, city sharding, and lobby are not implemented yet.
- The minigame apps are not embedded in the main game yet; `contribute()` is the
  narrow bridge they will use.

export function isWall(maze, x, y) {
  if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= maze.width || y >= maze.height) {
    return true;
  }
  return maze.tiles[y * maze.width + x] === TILE.WALL;
}
function drawTiles() {
  const halfWidth = viewWidth / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
  const halfHeight = viewHeight / (2 * TILE_PX) + 1;
  const minX = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.x - halfWidth));
  const maxX = Math.min(game.maze.width - 1, Math.ceil(camera.x + halfWidth));
  const minY = Math.max(0, Math.floor(camera.y - halfHeight));
  const maxY = Math.min(game.maze.height - 1, Math.ceil(camera.y + halfHeight));

  const wallShades = ['#3b2a22', '#35241d', '#433026'];

  for (let y = minY; y <= maxY; y += 1) {
    for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += 1) {
      const [screenX, screenY] = worldToScreen(x, y);
      const wall = game.maze.tiles[y * game.maze.width + x] === TILE.WALL;

      if (wall) {
        const shade = wallShades[(x * 31 + y * 17) % wallShades.length];
        ctx.fillStyle = shade;
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28)';
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 5, TILE_PX + 0.5, 5);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, 2);
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = (x + y) % 2 === 0 ? '#0d0a08' : '#0b0806';
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.018)';
        ctx.fillRect(screenX + TILE_PX - 1, screenY, 1, TILE_PX);
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY + TILE_PX - 1, TILE_PX, 1);
      }

      const owner = spawnTeamAt(game.maze, x, y);
      if (owner >= 0 && !wall) {
        ctx.fillStyle = withAlpha(game.teams[owner].color, 0.07);
        ctx.fillRect(screenX, screenY, TILE_PX + 0.5, TILE_PX + 0.5);
      }
    }
  }
}

function handleEvents(events) {
  for (const event of events) {
    switch (event.type) {
      case 'bomb':
        effects.push({
          type: 'blast',
          x: event.x,
          y: event.y,
          radius: event.radius,
          life: 620,
          total: 620,
        });
        toast('BOMB — COMMUNAL DEMOLITION', 'bad');
        break;
      case 'shot':
        effects.push({
          type: 'flash',
          x: event.x ?? null,
          y: event.y ?? null,
          playerId: event.playerId,
          life: 90,
          total: 90,
        });
        break;
      case 'item-collected': {
        const meta = ITEM_META[event.itemType];
        if (event.duplicate) {
          toast(`${meta.name} — ALREADY HELD`);
        } else if (event.immediate) {
          toast(`${meta.name} ADDED TO TEAM RESERVES`, 'good');
        } else {
          toast(`${meta.name} — PRESS SPACE TO SHARE`, 'good');
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'special-used': {
        const meta = ITEM_META[event.type];
        toast(`${meta.name} TRIGGERED FOR THE TEAM`, 'good');
        break;
      }
      case 'team-downed': {
        const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
        if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
          toast('TEAM DOWN — HALF WILL RETURN', 'bad');
        } else {
          toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} DOWN`, 'good');
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'team-revived': {
        const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
        if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
          toast(`REVIVED ${event.living} COMRADES — ${event.hp} HP`, 'good');
        } else {
          toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} REVIVED ${event.living}`, 'bad');
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'team-eliminated': {
        const team = game.teams[event.teamId];
        if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
          showBanner('ELIMINATED', 'Press R for a new match');
        } else {
          toast(`${team.name.toUpperCase()} ELIMINATED`, 'good');
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'effect-ended':
        if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
          toast(`${EFFECT_NAMES[event.effect] ?? event.effect} EXPIRED`);
        }
        break;
      case 'damage-blocked':
        if (event.teamId === me.teamId) {
          toast('+COAT ABSORBED THE HIT', 'good');
        }
        break;
      case 'ghost-task':
        if (event.playerId === me.id) {
          toast(`GHOST TASK — ${TASK_NAMES[event.task] ?? event.task}`, 'good');
        }
        break;
      case 'match-over': {
        const won = event.winnerTeamId === me.teamId;
        showBanner(
          won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT',
          won ? 'LAST TEAM STANDING' : `${game.teams[event.winnerTeamId].name.toUpperCase()} HOLDS THE MAZE`,
          won ? 'good' : 'bad',
        );
        break;
      }
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
}

  contribute(teamId, resources = {}) {
    const team = this.teams[teamId];
    if (!team || team.eliminated) {
      return { accepted: false, reason: 'eliminated' };
    }

    const hp = Number(resources.hp ?? 0);
    const ammo = Number(resources.ammo ?? 0);
    const dashSeconds = Number(resources.dashSeconds ?? 0);

    for (const value of [hp, ammo, dashSeconds]) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        throw new RangeError('contributions must be finite and non-negative');
      }
    }

    if (hp === 0 && ammo === 0 && dashSeconds === 0) {
      return { accepted: true, hp: 0, ammo: 0, dashSeconds: 0 };
    }

    team.hp += hp;
    team.ammo += ammo;
    team.dashSeconds += dashSeconds;

    return { accepted: true, hp, ammo, dashSeconds };
  }

It runs as a browser client,\noptionally against the dependency-free Node server in `../server/`, and embeds\nthe ghost minigames in an iframe console.\n\n## Run\n\nMultiplayer (recommended):\n\n```sh\nnode server/server.js\n```\n\nOpen `http://localhost:8080/main-game/`, pick a name and a collective, and join.\nThe server owns the maze, both teams, the bots, and one shared Dash Supplement\nFactory per team.\n\nLocal practice:\n\n```sh\ncd main-game\npython3 -m http.server 8000\n```\n\nOpen `http://localhost:8000/?local=1`. This runs the deterministic game in the\nbrowser with bots and local minigame contributions. Without `?local=1` the page\nexpects the WebSocket server.\n\n## Test\n\n```sh\ncd main-game && npm test\ncd ../server && npm test\n```\n\nThe main-game suite covers the three-pass maze generator, shared team resources,\ncombat, special items, ghost tasks, revival, elimination, winner detection, and\ncontributions. The server suite covers the WebSocket codec, room joining, bot\nreplacement, ghost-only contributions, shared factories, ownership, cursors,\nsnapshots, and match resets.\n\n## Controls\n\n| Input | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| `WASD` / arrows | Move |\n| Mouse | Aim |\n| Click / hold | Shoot |\n| `Shift` | Dash |\n| `Space` | Trigger the team special item |\n| `X` | Cycle minimap: nearby → full maze → comrats |\n| `↑` / `↓` in comrats | Select a teammate and draw a route |\n| `1` / `2` / `3` | Ghost task: soul / ammo / dash |\n| `R` | New match (local) or request a rematch (online) |\n\nGhosts get a **GHOST SHIFT** console. It loads one minigame at a time so a\nhidden tab never generates resources.\n\n## Structure\n\n- `src/maze.js` — deterministic three-pass maze. Every corridor and connector is\n  two tiles wide, and spawn rooms are at least 2×2.\n- `src/game.js` — pure rules: shared HP/ammo/dash, movement, combat, specials,\n  ghosts, revival, elimination, winner. It never reads wall-clock time.\n- `src/bots.js` — deterministic local bot inputs; the server reuses them for\n  bot-filled slots.\n- `src/net.js` — small reconnecting browser WebSocket client.\n- `src/ghost-console.js` — iframe host, tab switching, `postMessage` bridge, and\n  contribution relay.\n- `src/main.js` — renderer, HUD, input, lobby, snapshot interpolation, and the\n  local fallback shell.\n- `styles.css` / `index.html` — HUD, lobby, and ghost console layout.\n- `../server/` — static host, raw WebSocket server, authoritative `Room`, bot\n  roster, shared factories, and match reset.\n- `../shared/theme.css` — one communist palette shared by every page.\n\n## Minigame contract\n\nThe host and the embedded minigames exchange JSON through `postMessage`; only\nthe host talks to the server.\n\n- Minigame → host: `{ type: 'minigame-ready', game }` on boot.\n- Host → minigame: `{ type: 'state', hp, ammo, factory, livingTeammates, ... }`\n  at snapshot speed.\n- Soul Clicker → host: `{ type: 'contribute', game: 'soul-clicker', resources:\n  { hp } }`. Low CPS is a negative value; the server routes it through\n  `Game#drainHp` and skips the coat.\n- Bullet Press → host: `{ type: 'contribute', game: 'bullet-press', resources:\n  { ammo: 10 × multiplier } }` for each clean magazine.\n- Dash Supplement Factory → host: `{ type: 'factory-action', action, potId,\n  targetId }` and `{ type: 'pointer', x, y, active }`. function sendPointer(event, active = true) {
  if (!embedded) {
    return;
  }

  const now = performance.now();
  if (active && now - lastPointerSent < 60) {
    return;
  }
  lastPointerSent = now;

  const rect = ui.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (rect.width < 1 || rect.height < 1) {
    return;
  }

  embedPost({
    type: 'pointer',
    x: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width)),
    y: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height)),
    active,
  });
}

let docked = false;
let shiftTimer = null;

document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--slots', String(core.config.sequenceLength));

function getCssPx(name, fallback) {
  const value = Number.parseFloat(
    getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name),
  );
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}

function getManifoldInset() {
  return getCssPx('--manifold-inset', 48);
}

function getFeedLift() {
  return getCssPx('--feed-lift', 20);
}

function createTrunkBullet() {
  const bullet = document.createElement('span');
  bullet.className = 'manifold__bullet';
  bullet.dataset.id = String(trunkSerial);
  trunkSerial += 1;
  return bullet;
}

function buildTrunk() {
  if (!manifoldEl || !manifoldTrack || feedEls.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  manifoldTrack.replaceChildren();
  trunkBullets.length = 0;

  const first = feedEls[0];
  const feedsRect = feedsEl.getBoundingClientRect();
  const firstRect = first.getBoundingClientRect();
  const bulletWidth = firstRect.width * 0.86;
  const branchCenter = firstRect.left + firstRect.width / 2 - feedsRect.left;

  manifoldEl.style.left = `${Math.max(0, branchCenter - bulletWidth / 2)}px`;

  trunkPitch =
    feedEls.length > 1
      ? feedEls[1].getBoundingClientRect().left - firstRect.left
      : firstRect.width;

  if (trunkPitch <= 0) {
    trunkPitch = firstRect.width;
  }

  const width = feedsRect.width - Number.parseFloat(manifoldEl.style.left || '0');
  const count = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(width / trunkPitch) + 2);

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const bullet = createTrunkBullet();
    bullet.style.transform = `translateX(${i * trunkPitch}px)`;
    manifoldTrack.append(bullet);
    trunkBullets.push(bullet);
  }
}

function advanceTrunk() {
  if (trunkBullets.length === 0 || trunkPitch <= 0) {
    return;
  }

  const leaving = trunkBullets.shift();

  if (leaving) {
    leaving.dataset.leaving = 'true';
    leaving.style.transform = `translateX(${-trunkPitch}px)`;
    window.setTimeout(() => leaving.remove(), reduceMotion ? 0 : TRUNK_SHIFT_MS + 60);
  }

  trunkBullets.forEach((bullet, index) => {
    bullet.style.transform = `translateX(${index * trunkPitch}px)`;
  });

  const targetIndex = trunkBullets.length;
  const bullet = createTrunkBullet();
  bullet.style.transform = `translateX(${(targetIndex + 1) * trunkPitch}px)`;
  manifoldTrack.append(bullet);
  trunkBullets.push(bullet);

  if (reduceMotion) {
    bullet.style.transform = `translateX(${targetIndex * trunkPitch}px)`;
  } else {
    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      bullet.style.transform = `translateX(${targetIndex * trunkPitch}px)`;
    });
  }
}

function createFeedBullet() {
  const bullet = document.createElement('span');
  bullet.className = 'feed__bullet';
  return bullet;
}

function refillFeedQueue(feed) {
  const queue = feed.querySelector('.feed__queue');

  if (!queue) {
    return;
  }

  queue.replaceChildren();

  const height =
    (feed.clientHeight || feedsEl.clientHeight) - getManifoldInset() - getFeedLift();
  const count = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.floor((height - FEED_TOP_MARGIN_PX + BULLET_GAP_PX) / BULLET_PITCH_PX),
  );

  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const bullet = createFeedBullet();
    bullet.style.transform = `translateY(${-i * BULLET_PITCH_PX}px)`;
    queue.append(bullet);
  }
}

function advanceFeed(feed) {
  const queue = feed.querySelector('.feed__queue');

  if (!queue) {
    return;
  }

  const bullets = [...queue.querySelectorAll('.feed__bullet')];
  bullets.at(-1)?.remove();

  bullets.slice(0, -1).forEach((bullet, index) => {
    bullet.style.transform = `translateY(${-(index + 1) * BULLET_PITCH_PX}px)`;
  });

  const bullet = createFeedBullet();
  bullet.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';

function updateHud(nowMs) {
  const cps = clicker.cpsAt(nowMs);
  const rate = clicker.hpPerSecondAt(nowMs);
  const rateLabel = `${rate >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${rate.toFixed(1)}`;

  hpBar.dataset.band = clicker.band;
  hpBar.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', clicker.hp.toFixed(0));
  hpFill.style.width = `${(clicker.fillRatio * 100).toFixed(2)}%`;
  hpValue.textContent = `TEAM HP ${clicker.hp.toFixed(1)}`;
  hpMeta.textContent = `baseline ${clicker.baseline} · living ${clicker.livingTeammates} · CPS ${cps.toFixed(1)} · ${rateLabel} HP/s`;
}

/**
 * Pure Bullet Press rules. The browser owns rendering, key events, and animations.
 *
 * One sequence fills one magazine. Correct keys load green bullets; a wrong key
 * still fills a slot, but turns it red and breaks that magazine. Once every slot
 * is filled, the completed magazine is ejected and `nextMagazine()` can start a
 * fresh one.
 *
 * The production multiplier is a whole number based on how quickly the magazine
 * was completed: faster typing earns 5x, slower typing earns less. A broken
 * magazine produces nothing.
 */
export class BulletPress {
  constructor({ seed = 1, config = {}, rng } = {}) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };

    if (this.config.sequenceLength < 1) {
      throw new RangeError('sequenceLength must be at least 1');
    }
    if (this.config.charset.length < 1) {
      throw new RangeError('charset must contain at least one character');
    }
    if (this.config.maxMultiplier < 1) {
      throw new RangeError('maxMultiplier must be at least 1');
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(this.config.speedSteps) || this.config.speedSteps.length < 1) {
      throw new RangeError('speedSteps must contain at least one step');
    }

    this.rng = rng ?? createRng(seed);
    this.production = 0;
    this.brokenMagazines = 0;

    this.sequence = [];
    this.slots = [];
    this.index = 0;
    this.complete = false;
    this.brokenMagazine = false;

    this.startedAtMs = null;
    this.lastMultiplier = null;
    this.lastDurationMs = null;

    this.#generateSequence();
  }

  get expectedChar() {
    return this.complete ? null : this.sequence[this.index];
  }

  get filled() {
    return this.slots.length;
  }

  get magazinesProduced() {
    return this.production;
  }

  get magazine() {
    return {
      slots: this.slots.map((slot) => ({ ...slot })),
      filled: this.filled,
      broken: this.brokenMagazine,
      complete: this.complete,
    };
  }

  /** Start the timer for the magazine currently in the loading area. */
  start(nowMs) {
    if (this.startedAtMs !== null || !Number.isFinite(nowMs)) {
      return false;
    }

    this.startedAtMs = nowMs;
    return true;
  }

  multiplierForDuration(durationMs) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(durationMs) || durationMs < 0) {
      return 1;
    }

    const averageMs = durationMs / this.config.sequenceLength;

    for (const step of this.config.speedSteps) {
      if (averageMs <= step.maxAverageMs) {
        return Math.max(1, Math.min(this.config.maxMultiplier, step.multiplier));
      }
    }

    return 1;
  }

  /**
   * Type one character. Returns an event describing the slot that was filled.
   * `nowMs` must come from the host clock; rules never read the wall clock.
   */
  press(input, nowMs) {
    if (this.complete) {
      return { type: 'ignored', reason: 'complete' };
    }

    if (this.startedAtMs === null) {
      return { type: 'not-ready', reason: 'not-started' };
    }

    const char = String(input).toUpperCase();

    if (!/^[A-Z]$/.test(char)) {
      return { type: 'ignored', reason: 'invalid-character' };
    }

    const expected = this.expectedChar;
    const correct = char === expected;
    const slotIndex = this.index;

    this.slots.push({ char, expected, correct });
    this.index += 1;

    if (!correct) {
      this.brokenMagazine = true;
    }

    let multiplier = null;
    let durationMs = null;

    if (this.index >= this.config.sequenceLength) {
      this.complete = true;
      durationMs = Math.max(0, nowMs - this.startedAtMs);
      multiplier = this.brokenMagazine ? 0 : this.multiplierForDuration(durationMs);

      this.lastMultiplier = multiplier;
      this.lastDurationMs = durationMs;

      if (this.brokenMagazine) {
        this.brokenMagazines += 1;
      } else {
        this.production += multiplier;
      }
    }

    return {
      type: correct ? 'correct' : 'wrong',
      char,
      expected,
      correct,
      slotIndex,
      complete: this.complete,
      broken: this.brokenMagazine,
      multiplier,
      durationMs,
      production: this.production,
      magazinesProduced: this.magazinesProduced,
    };
  }

  /**
   * Start a fresh magazine once the current one is complete. If `nowMs` is
   * supplied the next magazine's timer starts immediately; otherwise the host
   * calls `start(nowMs)` when the magazine docks.
   */
  nextMagazine(nowMs) {
    if (!this.complete) {
      return null;
    }

    this.#generateSequence();
    this.slots = [];
    this.index = 0;
    this.complete = false;
    this.brokenMagazine = false;
    this.startedAtMs = Number.isFinite(nowMs) ? nowMs : null;

    return [...this.sequence];
  }

  /** Consume and return the whole magazines produced so far. */
  takeMagazines() {
    const count = this.production;
    this.production = 0;
    return count;
  }

  #generateSequence() {
    const chars = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < this.config.sequenceLength; i += 1) {
      chars.push(this.config.charset[Math.floor(this.rng() * this.config.charset.length)]);
    }

    this.sequence = chars;
  }
}

```js
function waitForMessage(predicate, timeout=4000) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const timer = setTimeout(()=>{ window.removeEventListener('message', on); reject(new Error('timeout')); }, timeout);
    function on(e) { if (e.origin!==location.origin) return; const d=e.data; if (predicate(d)) { clearTimeout(timer); window.removeEventListener('message', on); resolve(d);} }
    window.addEventListener('message', on);
  });
}
```

function setupLobby() {
  if (!NETWORK) {
    return;
  }

  ui.lobbyName.value = window.localStorage.getItem('commied-name') ?? '';
  ui.lobbyJoin.addEventListener('click', joinNetwork);
  ui.lobbyName.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
    if (event.key === 'Enter') {
      event.preventDefault();
      joinNetwork();
    }
  });
}

function joinNetwork() {
  const name = ui.lobbyName.value.trim();

  if (!name) {
    ui.lobbyStatus.textContent = 'A COMRADE NEEDS A NAME';
    ui.lobbyStatus.classList.add('is-error');
    ui.lobbyName.focus();
    return;
  }

  window.localStorage.setItem('commied-name', name);
  ui.lobbyJoin.disabled = true;
  ui.lobbyStatus.classList.remove('is-error');
  ui.lobbyStatus.textContent = 'JOINING THE COLLECTIVE…';
  net.join({ name, teamId: lobbyTeamId });
}

function renderLobbyTeams() {
  if (!ui.lobbyTeams || networkTeams.length === 0) {
    return;
  }

  const buttons = networkTeams.map((team) => {
    const button = document.createElement('button');
    button.type = 'button';
    button.className = 'lobby__team';
    button.dataset.team = String(team.id);
    button.style.borderColor = team.color;
    button.classList.toggle('is-selected', team.id === lobbyTeamId);

    const name = document.createElement('strong');
    name.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
    name.style.color = team.color;
    const hint = document.createElement('small');
    hint.textContent = team.id === lobbyTeamId ? 'SELECTED' : 'CHOOSE';
    button.append(name, hint);

    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      lobbyTeamId = team.id;
      renderLobbyTeams();
    });

    return button;
  });

  ui.lobbyTeams.replaceChildren(...buttons);
}

function handleNetMessage(message) {
  switch (message.type) {
    case 'hello':
      networkTeams = message.teams ?? [];
      renderLobbyTeams();
      break;
    case 'welcome':
      myClientId = message.clientId;
      myPlayerId = message.playerId;
      networkJoined = true;
      game = createNetworkView(message.maze);
      me = null;
      mazeBitmap = null;
      buildMazeBitmap();
      cameraReady = false;
      routeTargetId = myPlayerId;
      routePath = [];
      ghostTaskKey = null;
      ghostConsoleVisible = true;
      effects = [];
      ui.lobby.hidden = true;
      ui.banner.hidden = true;
      ui.banner.className = 'banner';
      ui.stats.conn.textContent = 'ONLINE';
      hudNext = 0;
      comratsNext = 0;
      break;
    case 'snapshot':
      applyNetworkSnapshot(message.snapshot);
      break;
    case 'join-rejected':
      ui.lobby.hidden = false;
      ui.lobbyJoin.disabled = false;
      ui.lobbyStatus.textContent = `JOIN FAILED — ${String(message.reason ?? 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase()}`;
      ui.lobbyStatus.classList.add('is-error');
      break;
    case 'spectating':
      ui.lobby.hidden = false;
      ui.lobbyJoin.disabled = false;
      ui.lobbyStatus.textContent = 'THE TEAMS ARE FULL — TRY AGAIN AFTER THE RESET';
      ui.lobbyStatus.classList.add('is-error');
      networkJoined = false;
      break;
    case 'contribution-rejected':
      break;

        toast(`FACTORY — ${String(message.reason).replaceAll('-', ' ').toUpperCase()}`);
      }
      break;
    default:
      break;
  }
}

    item.append(name, state);
    return item;
  });

    item.append(name);

/* ---------- HUD ---------- */

function updateHud(now, delta) {
  updateEffects(delta);

  if (!game || !me) {
    return;
  }

  if (now >= hudNext) {
    hudNext = now + 120;
    updateStats();
    updateReserves();
    updateHealth();
    updateMinimap();
  }

  if (now >= comratsNext) {
    comratsNext = now + 260;
    updateComrats();
  }
}

function updateEffects(delta) {
  effects = effects.filter((effect) => {
    effect.life -= delta;
    return effect.life > 0;
  });
}

function updateStats() {
  ui.stats.fps.textContent = `FPS ${Math.round(fps)}`;
  ui.stats.fps.className = `stat ${fps >= 50 ? '' : fps >= 30 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;

  ui.stats.frame.textContent = `${frameMs.toFixed(1)} ms`;
  ui.stats.frame.className = `stat ${frameMs <= 20 ? '' : frameMs <= 33 ? 'is-ok' : 'is-bad'}`;

  ui.stats.conn.textContent = NETWORK ? networkStatus : 'LOCAL';
  ui.stats.conn.className = `stat ${
    NETWORK && networkStatus === 'ONLINE' ? '' : 'is-dim'
  }`;

  const aliveA = game.teams[0].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(0);
  const aliveB = game.teams[1].eliminated ? 0 : countAlive(1);
  ui.stats.alive.textContent = `${aliveA} / ${aliveB}`;
  ui.stats.alive.className = 'stat is-dim';
}

function countAlive(teamId) {
  return game.players.filter((player) => player.teamId === teamId && player.alive).length;
}

function updateReserves() {
  const team = game.teams[me.teamId];
  ui.teamName.textContent = team.name.toUpperCase();
  ui.ammo.textContent = String(team.ammo);
  ui.dash.textContent = `${Math.floor(team.dashSeconds)}s`;
  ui.special.textContent = team.specials.length
    ? ITEM_META[team.specials[team.specials.length - 1]].name
    : '—';

    const span = document.createElement('span');
    const current = index === team.specials.length - 1;
    span.textContent = ITEM_META[type].name;
    if (current) {
      span.className = 'is-current';
    }
    return span;
  });
  ui.specialQueue.replaceChildren(...queue);
}

  ui.hpFill.style.width = `${ratio * 100}%`;
  ui.hpFill.className = `health__fill${

  }`;

/* ---------- Ghost shift bridge ---------- */

function setupGhostConsole() {
  ghostConsole = new GhostConsole({
    root: ui.ghostConsole,
    onContribute: contributeFromGhost,
    onFactoryAction: factoryAction,
    onPointer: (pointer) => {
      if (NETWORK && networkJoined) {
        net.send({ type: 'pointer', ...pointer });
      }
    },
    onTask: (task) => {
      ghostTaskKey = task;
      if (NETWORK && networkJoined) {
        net.send({ type: 'input', ghostTask: task });
      }
    },
    onClose: () => {
      ghostConsoleVisible = false;
      updateGhostOpenButton();
    },
  });

  ui.ghostOpen.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!me || me.alive) {
      return;
    }
    ghostConsoleVisible = true;
    if (NETWORK) {
      ghostConsole.show();
    } else {
      updateLocalGhostConsole({ force: true });
    }
    updateGhostOpenButton();
  });
}

function updateGhostOpenButton() {
  if (!ui.ghostOpen) {
    return;
  }
  ui.ghostOpen.hidden = !(me && !me.alive && ghostConsole && !ghostConsole.visible);
}

function contributeFromGhost({ game: source, resources = {} }) {
  if (NETWORK) {
    net?.send({ type: 'contribute', game: source, resources });
    return;
  }

  if (!me || me.alive || game.teams[me.teamId].eliminated) {
    return;
  }

  const hp = Number(resources.hp ?? 0);
  const ammo = Number(resources.ammo ?? 0);
  const dashSeconds = Number(resources.dashSeconds ?? 0);

  if (![hp, ammo, dashSeconds].every(Number.isFinite)) {
    return;
  }
  if (hp < 0) {
    const result = game.drainHp(me.teamId, -hp);
    handleEvents(result.events);
  } else {
    game.contribute(me.teamId, {
      hp: Math.max(0, hp),
      ammo: Math.max(0, ammo),
      dashSeconds: Math.max(0, dashSeconds),
    });
  }
}

const MIME = Object.freeze({
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8',
  '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8',
  '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8',

function safePath(urlPath) {
  let decoded;

  try {
    decoded = decodeURIComponent(urlPath);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }

  if (decoded.includes('\0')) {
    return null;
  }

  const normalized = decoded.endsWith('/') ? `${decoded}index.html` : decoded;
  const filePath = path.resolve(REPO_ROOT, `.${normalized}`);

  if (filePath !== REPO_ROOT && !filePath.startsWith(`${REPO_ROOT}${path.sep}`)) {
    return null;
  }

  return filePath;
}

function sendJson(response, status, value) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(value);
  response.writeHead(status, {
    'Content-Type': MIME['.json'],
    'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(body),
    'Cache-Control': 'no-store',
  });
  response.end(body);
}

async function serveStatic(request, response) {
  if (request.method !== 'GET' && request.method !== 'HEAD') {
    response.writeHead(405, { Allow: 'GET, HEAD' });
    response.end('Method Not Allowed');
    return;
  }

  const url = new URL(request.url, 'http://localhost');

  if (url.pathname === '/') {
    response.writeHead(302, { Location: '/main-game/' });
    response.end();
    return;
  }

  if (url.pathname === '/health') {
    sendJson(response, 200, { ok: true });
    return;
  }

  const filePath = safePath(url.pathname);
  if (!filePath) {
    response.writeHead(400);
    response.end('Bad Request');
    return;
  }

  let info;

  try {
    info = await stat(filePath);
  } catch {
    response.writeHead(404, { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' });
    response.end('Not Found');
    return;
  }

  if (info.isDirectory()) {
    response.writeHead(302, { Location: `${url.pathname.replace(/\/?$/, '/')}index.html` });
    response.end();
    return;
  }

  const type = MIME[path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase()] ?? 'application/octet-stream';
  response.writeHead(200, {
    'Content-Type': type,
    'Content-Length': info.size,
    'Cache-Control': 'no-cache',
    'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff',
  });

1: # commieD-Idea
2: 
3: 01main requisites
4: - Multiplayer maze shooter (browser-based)
5: - Large scale: 1000s of concurrent players across 200 cities globally
6: - Goal: be the last team standing
7: - the entire game is minimal in design and assets with the theme of communism(cause commieD=comm(unist)i(com)eD(y))
8: - Teams are divided uniformly.
9: - Teams share everything(from ammo, dashes, and even HP)
10: - If the team HP goes to 0, the entire team dies.
11: - A team is revived with only n/2 of the number of players who were alive in the previous run.
12: - the players who get to live is decided by a random player in the team.
13: - dead players(the n/2 not selected to play), act as ghosts, who search and collect resources for the team.
14: - on the number of players in team reaching one, the team dies. and is eliminated.
15: 02actual gameplay
16: - the entire game happens in a limited procedurally generated maze.
17: - each team begins in a large empty space surrounded by the maze. which is its spawn point. enemies cannot enter here. and spawn vulnerability is also here. 
18: - the whole game is top down 2d.
19: - the screen will consist of the following:
20: .top left=minimap which will either show the nearby area, minimap of the whole maze or a list of your teammates which you can quickly select from by using arrow keys to get the route to them.(these different modes can be switched by using x key)
21: .top center=performance and connection stats. strip format. with colour change for good, acceptable and bad stat values.
22: .bottom left=team reserves(ammo, dash, current powerup)
23: .bottom center=team health
24: .top right=comrats(stats of your comrades)
25: - you move around with wasd and arrowkeys, shift to dash. mouse to aim and click to shoot. hold click to for continuous fire. space for using special item
26: - special items are found around the world as collectibles strewn around in mazes
27: - the maze itself is a tiled system containing the following types of tiles: wall, free space,. this is saved and used by program with the help of a 1d array whose scale is fixed at a square for now.

136:   for (let index = 1; index < PLAYERS_PER_TEAM; index += 1) {

138:   }
139:   for (let index = 0; index < PLAYERS_PER_TEAM; index += 1) {
140:     game.join({ teamId: 1, isBot: true });
141:   }

143:   // The local demo keeps a larger reserve than a real match would receive
144:   // from the ghost minigames.
145:   for (const team of game.teams) {
146:     team.ammo = LOCAL_AMMO;

168: function buildMazeBitmap() {
169:   const { width, height, tiles, spawnZones } = game.maze;
170:   mazeBitmap = document.createElement('canvas');
171:   mazeBitmap.width = width;
172:   mazeBitmap.height = height;
173:   const bitmapCtx = mazeBitmap.getContext('2d');
174:   const image = bitmapCtx.createImageData(width, height);
175:   const data = image.data;
176:   const teamColors = game.teams.map((team) => hexToRgb(team.color));
177: 
178:   for (let index = 0; index < tiles.length; index += 1) {
179:     const offset = index * 4;
180:     const owner = spawnZones[index];
181: 
182:     if (tiles[index] === TILE.WALL) {
183:       data[offset] = 56;
184:       data[offset + 1] = 49;
185:       data[offset + 2] = 39;
186:     } else if (owner >= 0) {
187:       const color = teamColors[owner];
188:       data[offset] = Math.round(12 + color[0] * 0.32);
189:       data[offset + 1] = Math.round(10 + color[1] * 0.32);
190:       data[offset + 2] = Math.round(8 + color[2] * 0.32);
191:     } else {
192:       data[offset] = 14;
193:       data[offset + 1] = 12;
194:       data[offset + 2] = 10;
195:     }
196:     data[offset + 3] = 255;
197:   }
198: 
199:   bitmapCtx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
200: }
201: 
202: function hexToRgb(hex) {
203:   const value = hex.replace('#', '');
204:   return [
205:     parseInt(value.slice(0, 2), 16),
206:     parseInt(value.slice(2, 4), 16),
207:     parseInt(value.slice(4, 6), 16),
208:   ];
209: }
210: 
211: function worldToScreen(x, y) {
212:   return [
213:     (x - camera.x) * TILE_PX + viewWidth / 2,
214:     (y - camera.y) * TILE_PX + viewHeight / 2,
215:   ];
216: }
217: 
218: function screenToWorld(x, y) {
219:   return {
220:     x: camera.x + (x - viewWidth / 2) / TILE_PX,
221:     y: camera.y + (y - viewHeight / 2) / TILE_PX,
222:   };
223: }
